item.title: Our Story
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Our Story

Our Humble Beginnings in Hong Kong

Speedy Move, a Hong Kong family business, started small with just a single truck to serve local residents and small businesses. Our commitment to providing speedy and trustworthy service soon gained recognition throughout Hong Kong, resonating with the city's tradition of hard work and diligence. With the unique blend of our family's values and the Hong Kong spirit, we began to dream bigger.

Empowering Our Family and Community

As we continued to make junk disappear for countless satisfied customers in the heart of Hong Kong, our family was about empowering others who shared our vision.

Our dream extended to creating opportunities for truck drivers and individuals who work hard for a better future. We believe in giving back to our Hong Kong community, supporting local talent and fostering growth, just as other Hong Kong family businesses have done for generations.

A Hong Kong Family Business with a Commitment to Excellence

Throughout our journey, one thing remained constant: our commitment to excellence. We uphold the traditions of Hong Kong family businesses by continually investing in our team's training and development. This ensures that every member shares our family's values of trust, reliability, and eco-friendly practices. Hard work pays off, and we've seen it firsthand, a testament to the strong work ethic deeply ingrained in Hong Kong's heritage.

Talk to Us

Whether you're planning a junk or furniture removal project in the bustling heart of Hong Kong or have any inquiries about our services, we're always here to assist you. We understand that junk removal is a unique task, and you might have specific needs and questions. We're ready to address them all.

item.title: FAQ
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
FAQ

We Solve All Your Issues

Pricing and Payment

Speedy Move is a paid service specializing in junk removal, furniture disposal and moving in Hong Kong. Our pricing is all-inclusive, covering everything from picking up items at your location to responsible disposal or recycling fees. We provide you with a transparent, upfront price before starting the work, ensuring no surprises. We’ll make your furniture disappear while you relax—just point, and we’ll handle the rest!

To ensure accurate pricing, we offer a no-obligation onsite estimate. Our team will visit your location in person, assess the items you want to remove, and provide you with an exact price before starting the work. If you’re satisfied with the price, we proceed with the job. If not, simply let us know, and we’ll respect your decision.

At Speedy Move, we accept Payme, FPS, Alipay, Credit Card, Bank Transfer and other electronic payments as payment methods.

At Speedy Move, we understand that you may want to know the cost of our removal service upfront. We’re pleased to offer an estimate process that provides a more accurate price even before our team arrives. You can get a better idea of the expected cost by simply sharing photos of the items you need to be removed, along with your address. This enables us to assess the volume and nature of your furniture items, allowing us to provide a more precise estimate over the phone. To utilize this option, contact our customer support team, and we’ll guide you through the process of submitting photos and your address. This way, you can enjoy clarity and peace of mind regarding the cost well in advance of the furniture removal. Speedy Move is dedicated to ensuring a straightforward and transparent experience for our valued customers.

My Appointment

On your appointment day, our team will call you 30 minutes before the start of your appointment window. They’ll confirm the arrival time and any other necessary details.

You can change or cancel your appointment at any time. Just give us a call at +852 9847 7838, and we’ll be happy to assist you with any necessary changes.

The ability to remove items without you being onsite depends on your location. In some cases, our teams can complete the job if items are easily accessible and if payment can be processed over the phone. However, some locations may require your presence during item removal.

Yes, Speedy Move offers No Contact Furniture Removal for the comfort and safety of our customers and teams. This service ensures that items can be removed without direct contact.

What We Take

Speedy Move can assist you in getting rid of various items, including mattresses, furniture, electronics, and other bulky items. We can remove almost anything that two people can lift and load, provided it’s not toxic or hazardous. Our team will remove items from any location, such as your garage, attic, backyard, or anywhere else.

Our ability to accept paint varies by location due to differences in local regulations. For locations that do accept paint, please note that they may require it to be fully dried before removal. To inquire about paint removal, call us, and we’ll confirm if your location can accommodate it.

Absolutely! Speedy Move is equipped to handle large and bulky items. As long as two or more people can lift and load the item, we’ll gladly remove it for you.

Speedy Move strives to be environmentally responsible, recycling and donating items to reduce landfill waste, while complying with local regulations.

The list of unaccepted items varies by location to adhere to local regulations. Generally, we don’t accept toxic or hazardous items, and some locations might not accept car or truck chassis.

Service and Location

Yes, Speedy Move is fully licensed and insured. We have insurance covering damages to both individuals and property for every booking.

Speedy Move covers all area across Hong Kong. To check if we service your area, you can start a booking by letting us know your location’s details.

At Speedy Move, we understand that your furniture removal and cleaning needs may arise at any time. That’s why we’re available around the clock, 24/7, to serve you. Our customer support call center is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, ensuring that you can reach us whenever it’s convenient for you. You can book appointments online at any time, allowing you to find an appointment window that perfectly aligns with your schedule. Whether it’s early morning, late at night, or even on weekends and holidays, we’re here to meet your furniture removal and cleaning needs at your convenience. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we’re dedicated to making your space cleaner and more organized whenever you need us.

Other Questions?

At Speedy Move, we pride ourselves on our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our customers in Hong Kong have experienced the excellence of our furniture removal services and have shared their feedback.

We value your feedback and continuously strive to provide the best furniture removal services in Hong Kong. Your satisfaction is our ultimate goal, and we thank our customers for their trust in our services. If you've recently used Speedy Move, we'd love to hear from you. Your feedback helps us improve and serve you better.

item.title: Donation
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Donation of Furniture

Give back to our community

Cash Back Now!

Donate Furniture for a Better Hong Kong and Get Cash Back!

At Speedy Move, we aspire to become the biggest donor of furniture in Hong Kong. When you choose our furniture disposal services, you're not just clearing your space, you're making a significant impact on the lives of others in Hong Kong. Our mission is not only to provide efficient and eco-friendly furniture removal but also to support local communities, promote sustainable living, and reward you with a cash back opportunity.

For a limited time, we're offering a free furniture donation service to make your generosity even more impactful. The offer will provide until 30th June 2024.

Why Donate Furniture?

  • Help Poor Families: Your furniture can find a new home with families who may not have the means to purchase brand-new items. Your contribution makes their lives more comfortable and cozy.

  • Charitable Organizations: We collaborate with respected charities and non-profits in Hong Kong, including St. James Settlement, Salvation Army, Crossroads Foundation, Mother's Choice, and Christian Action. Your furniture donations directly support their initiatives, which help those in need.

  • Sustainable Living: Donating furniture promotes a culture of sustainability. Rather than adding to waste and landfill, your items find a second life, reducing the environmental impact.

Cash Back Offer:

At Speedy Move, we appreciate your generosity. When you choose to donate your furniture with us, you'll receive a cash back incentive as a token of our gratitude. This offer allows you to contribute to a good cause while also receiving a financial benefit.

Limited Time Free Donation Service:

For a short period, we are offering a free furniture donation service as an extra incentive to encourage your participation. This means that you can donate your gently used furniture at no cost while making a significant difference in the lives of those in need.

Why Donate Now?

  • Helping Hong Kong: Your donations support local communities and contribute to a better Hong Kong.
  • Furniture for Families: Provide gently used furniture to those in need.
  • Charity Collaborations: Partnering with organizations like St. James Settlement, Salvation Army, Crossroads Foundation, Mother's Choice, and Christian Action.
  • Sustainability: Promoting eco-friendly practices and reducing waste.
  • Cash Back Incentive: Receive financial rewards for your charitable act.
  • Limited Time Offer: Take advantage of our free donation service for a limited period.

How to Donate Your Furniture and Get Cash Back?

  1. Schedule a Pick-Up: When you use our furniture removal service, let us know that you'd like to donate your items and take advantage of the cash back offer. We'll coordinate a convenient pick-up time that suits your schedule.
  2. Gently Used Furniture: We accept gently used furniture, including sofas, tables, chairs, and more. Your donations should be in good condition to benefit those in need.
  3. Environmental Impact: Your donations play a crucial role in reducing waste and supporting Hong Kong's sustainability goals.
  4. Community Support: We also collaborate with local charities like Po Leung Kuk, Feeding Hong Kong, and more to ensure your donations reach those who need them most.

Why Choose Speedy Move for Furniture Removal and Donations?

  • Local Commitment: We are a Hong Kong-based company deeply rooted in the community, ensuring your donations stay within the city and help local residents.
  • Eco-Friendly Practices: We prioritize responsible disposal and recycling, contributing to a cleaner and greener Hong Kong.
  • Cash Back Incentive: We value your contribution and show our appreciation by offering a cash back opportunity.
  • Comprehensive Service: From furniture removal to donation coordination, we provide a one-stop solution to meet all your furniture needs.

Talk to us

When you donate furniture with Speedy Move, you become part of a meaningful change in Hong Kong, and you also get cash back as a reward. Together, we create a more sustainable, caring community, and you enjoy the financial benefits of your generosity. For a limited time, we're offering a free furniture donation service, making your charitable act even more rewarding. Contact us today to schedule a furniture removal and donation service that makes a real difference and gives back to you.

We serve various areas in Hong Kong, including Tuen Mun, Kai Tak, Sha Tin, Tai Kok Tsui, Sai Ying Pun, and many more.

Your furniture can change lives, and we're here to make your charitable act even more rewarding. Donate today and get cash back while helping those in need!

Contact Info

  • WhatsApp or Call: (852) 9847 7838
  • Address: Room N, 9/F, Kwun Tong Industrial Centre, 460 Kwun Tong Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong
  • Email: info@speedy-move.com

item.title: Household Furniture Disposal
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Household Furniture Disposal and Junk Removal

HOUSEHOLD FURNITURE DISPOSAL​

Our Household Furniture Disposal service in Hong Kong is designed to make getting rid of unwanted furniture items hassle-free and environmentally responsible. We understand that households often accumulate old or unused furniture over time, and disposing of it can be a challenging task. That's where we step in to provide a convenient and sustainable solution.

Explore

Step 1: Contact Us The first step is to get in touch with us. You can reach us via phone or our online booking system. We have a friendly customer support team ready to assist you. When you contact us, provide details about the furniture items you need to dispose of, their sizes, and your location.

 

Step 2: Assessment and Quote Upon receiving your request, we'll assess the information you've provided. If necessary, we may request photos of the furniture items. This helps us determine the volume and weight of the furniture. Based on this assessment, we'll provide you with a detailed and transparent quote, including all costs associated with the disposal.

 

Step 3: Scheduling Once you're satisfied with the quote, we'll work with you to schedule a convenient pickup time. We offer flexible scheduling options to accommodate your availability. Our team will arrive at your location on the agreed-upon date and time.

 

Step 4: On-Site Inspection Upon arrival, our trained professionals will conduct an on-site inspection. They will verify the furniture items to be removed, ensuring all items match the provided details. At this point, you can discuss any specific requirements or concerns you may have.

 

Step 5: Safe and Efficient Removal Our team will proceed with the safe and efficient removal of your furniture. They will carefully disassemble items if necessary, wrap them to prevent any damage during transit, and transport them to our vehicle. Our professionals are trained to handle items of all sizes, from small chairs to large sofas and cabinets.

 

Step 6: Eco-Friendly Disposal Once the furniture is loaded onto our vehicle, we'll transport it to a designated facility for disposal. We prioritize eco-friendly practices, and our approach includes:

  • Recycling: Whenever possible, we'll recycle materials like wood, metal, and plastics.
  • Donation: Furniture in good condition may be donated to local charities, ensuring it benefits those in need.
  • Responsible Disposal: Items that can't be recycled or donated will be disposed of in an environmentally responsible manner to minimize waste and reduce our impact on landfills.

Step 7: Cleaning and Inspection After the furniture is removed from your premises, our team will ensure the area is left clean and tidy. We take care of any debris or remnants, leaving your space clutter-free.

 

Step 8: Payment and Documentation Once the job is complete, we'll process the payment based on the previously agreed-upon quote. You'll receive an invoice and a receipt for your records.

 

Step 9: Customer Satisfaction Your satisfaction is essential to us. We'll ask for your feedback and any additional comments to ensure you're happy with the service provided.

Our goal is to make the entire process of household furniture disposal as convenient, eco-friendly, and transparent as possible. You can trust Speedy Move to handle the job with professionalism and care, leaving you with a clutter-free and sustainable living space.

Talk to us

Whether you're planning a furniture removal project in the bustling heart of Hong Kong or have any inquiries about our services, we're always here to assist you. We understand that furniture removal is a unique task, and you might have specific needs and questions. We're ready to address them all.

We Are Always Open to Talk

Get In Touch

item.title: Pricing
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Upfront & Transparent Pricing

How much does Speedy Move cost?

Junk Removal and Moving Pricing

How we estimate your quote

Our primary mission is to provide excellent service, and we ensure our pricing is transparent. We consider several factors before and during your move to deliver value at a fair price and ensure your needs are met.
The factors that affect your pricing include location, distance from the parking area, the time needed to complete the job, the number of movers we need for the crew, the number and size of items to be moved, and any assembly or disassembly needed.

Furniture Disposal Pricing

We offer comprehensive furniture disposal services, including disassembly, safe transport, and eco-friendly disposal. Our pricing is customized based on factors like total volume, item size, weight, and location. We provide free, upfront estimates to ensure transparency. Our skilled team handles disassembly for bulky items like wardrobes and beds, protecting your home and belongings throughout the process. We prioritize recycling and donations to minimize waste. Choose Speedy Move for expert handling, tailored solutions, and environmentally responsible disposal.

Junk Removal Pricing

Our junk removal rates differ by job and circumstance. Our junk pricing is determined by several factors, including: total volume, size of items, weight of items and location
We deliver your free junk removal estimate before the assignment so you know exactly what you are paying for. These quotes are customized to match your unique item requirements and expectations.

Moving Pricing

Whether you're moving long-distance or just down the street, we offer comprehensive moving quotes unique to your needs. Speedy Move will review these factors before delivering your estimate: distance, access to the items, and duration of the job. Additional services, such as comprehensive packing, loading, unloading, and packing materials, are at an extra cost.
Before we move any furniture, you are guaranteed a free, no-obligation estimate. This means that you will never be surprised by hidden fees or charges after the move.

Talk to Us

Please note that our pricing can vary based on factors such as location, the quantity and type of items, and specific service requirements. To get an accurate estimate for your unique needs, we recommend requesting a free, no-obligation onsite estimate. Our friendly customer service will assess your situation and provide you with a precise quote before starting the job.

At Speedy Move, we are committed to ensuring that our customers receive excellent value for the services we provide. If you have any questions about our pricing or want to discuss a custom project, please don't hesitate to contact us. We are here to meet your needs with the best possible pricing and service quality.

Note: All prices are subject to change based on service area, specific job requirements, and other factors. For the most accurate pricing, please request an onsite estimate.

We Clear Junk Fast!

Your Trusted Junk Removal and Moving Expert in Hong Kong

Our Services

Junk Removal Service

Our professional junk removal teams can help assist with decluttering your home or office by removing just about any unwanted items. Whether you’re preparing for a move, cleaning out an estate, or downsizing, Speedy Move is here to help.

Furniture Disposal Service

We offer sofa, bed, mattress, wardrobe, television, washing machine, cabinet, refrigerator, dining table set, home appliance and other furniture recycling and disposal service in Hong Kong.

Moving Service

We offer wrap protection, disassembly & assembly, full packing services, point to point moving for residential, commercial and industrial building in Hong Kong.

Demolition & Restoration

We offer unauthorized structures demolition, office building demolition, home demolition, shopping mall demolition and restoration, restaurant demolition, factory building demolition, rooftop house demolition.

We Move What You Want
Remove What You Don't

Speedy Move will take the weight off your shoulders with our stress-free junk removal and moving services. We offer comprehensive packages, item transport, packing, and unloading services. We even provide free packing materials to get you started.

  • Junk Removal
  • Furniture Disposal
  • Moving
  • Demolition

Junk Removal

Speedy Move offers eco-friendly junk removal and trash pickup services throughout Hong Kong. Once an appointment is scheduled, our experts will pick up any unwanted items and carefully deliver them to designated government garbage collection points, recycle centers or government-approved landfills in cases where the item cannot be reused. We can remove just about any item, including appliances and trash the same-day or next day. Schedule your junk pickup time to get a free, no obligation quote on services now! 

Furniture Disposal

Our furniture pickup services include single items, bulky furniture and even estate cleanouts. Whether you're in need of sofa removal, mattress disposal, or other junk removal services, we can help! If your used furniture is in good shape, we’ll donate to local charities or recycle if we can to avoid landfills. Our reliable furniture removal includes a free estimate so you know exactly how much it will cost to haul away your unwanted furniture. There are no hidden fees and no obligations. Schedule your furniture pickup time now! 

Moving Service

Speedy Move offers comprehensive local moving services for residential moving and commercial moving. Our expert movers are professional trained to handle various fragile or heavy items, ensuring your valuables gets from point A to point B exactly how you want them. We work closely with you to determine a custom, upfront moving quote based on your destination and the number of items you're transporting.

Demolition Service

Hiring the Speedy Move team to manage your demolition work is a great way to cut out the middleman with your home renovation projects. At Speedy Move, we’re more than just your average junk removal service. We offer demolition and debris removal services for any room in your home or office. No matter your needs, our team of professional demolition and debris removal specialists are ready to help make your upcoming home improvement project easy.

Sofa and Couch

Trash

Appliance

Hear From Our Happy Clients

Speedy Move Company Limited

Hong Kong's Most Trusted Name in Junk Removal

Speedy Move is a full-service junk removal and moving company serving areas throughout Hong Kong. We offer junk removal, furniture disposal, demolition and moving service for homes and businesses as well, including offices, retail properties, construction sites, and more!

Our friendly, uniformed teams can help you move anything you want and get rid of anything you don't want. We care about the environment and are committed to safe and responsible disposal, keeping items out of the landfill wherever possible.

Recycle and Donate Used Furniture

At Speedy Move, we do our best to recycle and donate items as many items as possible. We work with community centers, non-profit organizations, and donation centers to pass on items after we haul them away. You can rest assured that your items will be handled responsibly by our teams, in an effort to reduce our environmental impact.

  • Furniture for Families: We help donate second hand furniture to support local communities and contribute to a better Hong Kong.
  • Sustainability: Promoting eco-friendly practices and reducing waste.
  • Cash Back Incentives: Limited offer to receive financial rewards for your charitable act.

item.title: 搬屋 (For backup)
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
搬屋服務

值得信賴 搬屋專家

搬屋服務包括

1

住宅搬屋服務

我們提供專業的住宅搬遷服務以滿足您的需求。無論您的搬家數量或目的地如何，我們將細心處理搬家流程的每一步。

2

辦公室搬遷服務

我們的商業搬遷解決方案可確保您的企業和辦公室搬遷無憂。我們會包裝公司物品（例如辦公傢俱、電子設備）並將其搬遷到新場所。

傑出服務獎

榮獲香港商報香港最佳運輸服務獎

實踐環保

致力保護環境和回收

社區責任

捐贈狀況良好的物品，並確保它們找到新居。

搬遷流程

第1步：評估和報價

評估： 通過電話或電子郵件聯繫我們，討論您的搬家需求，包括您的搬家規模、您當前的位置、目的地以及您可能有的任何具體要求。一旦我們瞭解您的搬家要求，我們的團隊將安排評估您的物品和搬遷的後勤工作。

報價：此評估有助於我們確定所需的搬遷人員人數、所需的運輸類型以及處理易碎古董、鋼琴或藝術品等物品所需的任何專用設備。評估后，我們將為您提供詳細透明的搬遷服務報價。

第 2 步：搬遷日的準備工作

整理：檢查您的物品，決定要帶走什麼以及要處理或捐贈什麼。如果需要，我們可以協助棄置傢俬。

打包：您可以選擇自己打包您的物品，或者我們提供專業的打包服務。如果您更喜歡自行打包，請確保您有足夠的打包用品，例如箱子、膠帶、氣泡膜包裝和包裝紙。

第 3 步：搬遷日

庫存： 我們將對所有要搬遷的物品進行清點。每件商品都將仔細貼上標籤，以確保正確處理和放置在您的新地點。

打包：如果您選擇了我們的打包服務，我們將安全地打包您的物品，為搬家做準備。

拆卸：對於需要拆卸的物品，例如傢俬或大型電器，我們的團隊會小心翼翼地將它們拆開。

裝載：我們會將您的包裝物品裝載到我們維護良好且設備齊全的搬遷車輛上，確保您的物品在運輸過程中安全無虞。

第 4 步：運輸和卸貨

卸貨： 您的物品將被小心地從車輛上卸下。

開箱：如果您選擇了我們的開箱服務，我們將仔細拆箱並重新組裝您的傢俬和電器，將它們放在指定的房間內。

第 5 步：搬遷後服務和簽核

傢俱放置：我們的團隊將根據您的規格放置傢俱。

清除碎屑： 我們可以協助清除包裝材料和任何不需要的物品。

傢俱組裝：如果傢俬或電器因搬遷而被拆卸，我們將重新組裝。

最終檢查：在我們離開之前，我們將進行最終檢查，以確保您的所有物品都在正確的位置並且狀況良好。我們會讓您在搬遷中簽字以確認您的滿意度。

附近的搬屋服務

 作為一家全方位的搬屋公司，我們致力於幫助我們的住宅和商業客戶提供定製的搬屋體驗。我們服務範圍涵蓋全港，並且隨時樂意為您提供幫助。

Furniture Disposal Service
in Hong Kong

Your Trusted Furniture Disposal Expert

Furniture Removal & Pickup Services

Getting rid of old furniture isn’t always an easy process. It's heavy, awkward, hard to maneuver and nearly impossible to do on your own. You may even need extra hands and tools, such as a dolly, to move the heavier pieces.

Don’t try to haul away old furniture on your own. Contact a professional junk removal company that knows how to get rid of old furniture safely and efficiently.

1

Residential Furniture Removal

We offer top-notch residential furniture removal services for a sparkling home. We also help remove and transport them to a recycling or donation facility.

2

Commercial Furniture Removal

Our commercial furniture removal solutions ensure a seamless disposal for your business and office. We ensure eco-friendly disposal and align with responsible environmental practices.

3

Cleanout Services

Count on us for efficient residential and commercial cleanout services tailored to your needs.

List of Furniture We Take

Wardrobe Disposal

  • Wardrobe
  • Cabinet
  • Build in wardrobe disassembly
  • Wall mounted cabinet
  • Cupboard

Bed and Mattress Disposal

  • Bed frame
  • Mattress

Table and Chair Disposal

  • Dinning table

  • Pool or billiard table

Sofa and Couch Disposal

  • Sofa
  • Couch
  • Ottoman
  • Armchair
  • Sofa bed

Carpet and Rug Disposal

  • Area rug
  • Old carpet
  • Floor coverings
  • Wool carpeting
  • Nylon or polyester carpet

Appliance Removal

  • Refrigerator
  • Wine fridge
  • Washing machine
  • Microwave
  • Humidifier

Why Choose Speedy Move To Remove And Recycle Your old Furniture

Speedy Move makes getting rid of furniture and junk easy. We’re in your neighborhood and are ready to make your junk disappear! You don’t have to worry about moving anything out to the curb for us, we’ll grab those heavy items right from where they’re located, load them onto our trucks, and ensure that they’re handled responsibly from the minute we take them off your hands.
When you need a furniture removal service in Causeway Bay, bed disposal in North Point, or a mattress pick-up service in Mid-levels, we’re in your neighborhood—find Speedy Move location near you.

Furniture Removal Pricing

We take pride in offering clear and easy-to-understand pricing. Before we begin you will always receive a free, no obligation estimate for the removal and disposal or donation of any item.
The following factors impact how much we charge for furniture removal:

  • Amount of furniture
  • Single-item pricing
  • Heavy items
  • Location
  • Disposal fees
  • Time of year
  • Accessibility

Recycling & donating your old furniture

At Speedy Move, we always remember the three Rs—Reduce, Reuse, Recycle. Disposing of your old items in the most responsible and environmentally friendly way possible is a commitment that’s important to us. Many common household items like sofas or couches, bookcases, desks and bed frames are recyclable if taken to the proper processing facilities, and we always ensure that we do so with the items that can be recycled. 
For items that aren’t recyclable, we’ll link up with local charity groups to see if they have a need for furniture donations. If the items are broken or otherwise can’t be recycled or donated, we’ll ensure that they’re properly disposed of. You can learn more about what type of furniture items can be recycled in the FAQs below.

All works comply with the Buildings Ordinance and environmental regulations.
Select your service type for detailed specifications.

  • Home Demolition
  • Shop Demolition

Home Demolition

We specialize in comprehensive demolition services for aged buildings, tenement houses, and private residences. Our scope includes: Tile removal from walls | Floor demolition | Obsolete pipe and wiring elimination
Our licensed team strictly follows Buildings Department guidelines using dust-contained equipment to minimize neighborhood impact. Post-demolition, we restore sites to bare-shell condition and provide Waste Disposal Certificates and Structural Safety Reports.
Workflow: On-site evaluation → Quote submission → Contract signing → Commencement within 7 days

Shop Demolition

Our specialized shop clearance solutions for retail environments include display shelf removal, illuminated sign dismantling, and floor restoration. With expertise in mall and street shop regulations, we can clear 2,000 sq.ft spaces within 4 working days. Utilizing modular disassembly technology, we achieve 90% recycling rates for metal frames and glass panels, significantly reducing construction waste. Optional overnight operations minimize daytime business disruption.
Key Documentation:
- Project schedule
- Waste classification plan (provided upon contract signing)
- Compliance with all shopping mall operational guidelines

Restaurant Demolition

We handle F&B demolition projects including exhaust duct removal, kitchen equipment clearance, and grease contamination cleanup. Our FEHD-certified team uses industrial steam cleaners to eliminate stubborn grease deposits, preventing hygiene inspection issues. We professionally dismantle refrigerators, cooking ranges, and ventilation systems with specialized chemical waste disposal.
Specialized Equipment: Explosion-proof tools for safe gas line disconnection.
Guarantee: Obtain Grease Removal Certificates within 72 hours post-project, ensuring compliance with food establishment licensing standards.

Office Demolition

We execute comprehensive office clearance projects including partition wall removal, raised floor system dismantling, and network wiring elimination. Using low-noise equipment (<65dB), our operations won't disrupt neighboring businesses. Includes document shredding services to ensure complete data protection.
Workflow:
After-hours demolition → Daily debris removal → Handover of (Project Completion Certificate) upon finishing
Case Study:
Completed 15,000 sq.ft full-floor demolition in Admiralty Grade-A office within 12 days, receiving formal management office approval.

Unauthorized Structures Demolition

We professionally remove rooftop structures, canopies, and illegal partitions with full compliance to the Buildings Ordinance. Our team handles all Buildings Department approval paperwork and utilizes aerial work platforms and mini-breakers for safe overhead demolition. Emergency services available - commencement within 72 hours of receiving removal orders.
Essential Documentation:
Demolition Order Completion Certificate
Structural Safety Declaration (provided upon project completion)
Risk Management:
All projects are covered by HK$10 million third-party liability insurance for owner protection.

Structural Restoration

We repair load-bearing walls, beams, and other structural elements damaged by alterations, strictly adhering to original Buildings Department approved plans with ±2cm precision. Our solutions include anti-corrosion rebar coatings and high-strength concrete, with final delivery of Load-Bearing Test Reports. For heritage buildings, our Antiquities and Monuments Office-certified team has successfully restored Grade II historic structures.
Technical Tools:
3D laser scanners, Concrete strength testers
Quality Assurance:
All restorations are certified by registered structural engineers to guarantee 100% compliance and safety.

How Our Service Works

We promise to actively monitor, follow up on details and supervise the project during the construction period.

  1. Free Consultation & Quote
    Call or submit your request online – receive a preliminary demolition cost estimate within 30 minutes at no charge!
  2. Online or On-Site Assessment & Planning
    Our expert team conducts property inspections, takes precise measurements, and provides a detailed Demolition Quotation with a tailored work plan.
  3. Contract Signing & Commencement
    A formal contract clearly outlines the project scope, pricing, and waste disposal terms to protect both parties.
  4. Completion & Handover
    We provide a Demolition Certificate and Waste Disposal Records to ensure full compliance with environmental regulations.

Approved Public Works Contractors

Our company is a Hong Kong Government-approved public works contractor (Registration No.: MWC 80/2010), legally authorized to perform various demolition works. We specialize in providing corporate clients with professional demolition and restoration services that comply with government standards, ensuring all projects are fully lawful and regulation-compliant.

Safety First

Our projects are all equipped with third-party liability insurance and labor insurance to ensure safety and hassle-free.

Smooth Process

Complete the demolition and restoration project on schedule with efficiency.

Comprehensive and Considerate

Carry out the demolition in accordance with the guidelines, including work packaging and materials and providing the required documents.

Why Choose Us

1

Government-Approved Qualifications

Partnering with licensed contractors registered under the Minor Works System for legally compliant construction with guaranteed quality.

2

Professional Team & Equipment

20 years of demolition experience, utilizing advanced European equipment to triple work efficiency.

3

Comprehensive Insurance Coverage

All projects carry HKD $10M liability coverage and worker accident protection for complete client security.

4

Eco-Friendly Commitment

Waste materials are sorted and recycled to ensure compliance with sustainable development principles, fulfilling our corporate social responsibility (CSR).

5

Transparent Communication

Daily photo updates and a dedicated project manager ensure clear communication throughout your project.

Demolition FAQ

✅ Detailed Timeline Analysis

Standard Residential (300-500 sq.ft):
✓ Basic demolition: 1-2 working days
✓ Including waste removal: +0.5 day

Commercial Space (500-1000 sq.ft):
✓ Office: 2-3 days (with system furniture removal)
✓ Restaurant: 3-4 days (including exhaust system dismantling)

✅ Key Factors Affecting Duration

  • Building structure (concrete walls require 50% more time than drywall)
  • Waste disposal (no service elevator adds 30% time for high-rises)
  • Work restrictions (some commercial buildings only allow after-hours work)

✅ Important Notes for Owners

  • Recommended: Allow 10-15% buffer time for unexpected delays
  • Available: Daily progress reports with site photos

✅ Pricing Components

✅ Hidden Cost Alerts

  • Asbestos Inspection: $1500-3000 (Mandatory for pre-1985 buildings)
  • Night Work: 20-30% surcharge (Noise permit required)

✅ Cost-Saving Tips

  • Self-removal of recyclables (e.g. metal doors/windows) saves $3-5/sq.ft
  • 5-10% discount typically available in off-season (Jan-Mar)

✅ Essential Insurance Types

  • Third-Party Liability Insurance (Min. $5M coverage): Protects against damage to neighboring properties/public facilities
  • Workers' Accident Insurance: Legal requirement for on-site labor protection
  • Comprehensive Project Insurance (Optional): Covers fire, flooding, and other accidents

✅ Owner Checklist

  • Request valid insurance certificates from contractors
  • Verify policy coverage spans the entire project duration

✅ Eco-Friendly Recycling Options

Recyclables (metal/plastic/glass):

  • Processed by government-approved recyclers
  • Some charities accept donations (e.g. furniture/appliances)

E-waste (computers/TVs/AC units):

  • Handled by licensed recyclers per EPD regulations
  • Check community collection points or "Green@Community" program

✅ Non-Recyclable Waste

  • Delivered to designated government waste stations
  • Full compliance with environmental laws

✅ Important Notes

  • Verify item condition before donation
  • Large furniture requires self-arranged transport or pickup service

✅ Inspection Checklist

✅ Document Verification
Must obtain:
✓ Demolition Completion Certificate (specifying work scope)
✓ Waste Disposal Records (weight/processing method)
✓ Asbestos Test Report (if applicable)

✅ Dispute Prevention

  • Take 360° panoramic photos for documentation
  • Sign mutual "Handover Confirmation"

✅ General Guidelines

Short-term Projects (1-2 days):

  • Occupants may stay but should seal off work areas
  • Sensitive individuals (e.g. children/elderly) may avoid active work hours

Large-scale Projects (3+ days):

  • Temporary relocation advised for extensive works/dust-heavy projects
  • Implement dust containment (e.g. room sealing) if remaining onsite

✅ Key Considerations

  • Coordinate special arrangements with contractors in advance
  • Expect noise/dust - prepare necessary protections
  • Secure valuables away from work zones

✅ Basic Coverage

Workmanship Guarantee (Typically 6 Months):

  • Free repairs for structural issues caused by demolition (e.g. wall cracks/leaks)
  • Excludes damages from subsequent renovations/other works

Waste Disposal Verification:

  • Ensures legal waste processing to prevent owner liability

✅ Dispute Resolution

  • Request third-party building inspector review if needed
  • Determine responsibilities per contract terms

Important Notes:

  • Contact our team for detailed terms clarification
  • Keep completion certificates for service claims
  • Non-project related issues (e.g. pre-existing defects) excluded

item.title: Mattress Removal
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Mattress Removal Service
in Hong Kong

Your Trusted Mattress Disposal Expert

Mattress Disposal and Removal Solutions

Have an old mattress or broken box springs that need to be removed from your home? Don’t struggle with stairs or fight hallways, Instead, call Speedy Move. When you schedule our mattress disposal service, we do all the heavy lifting and difficult maneuvering for you! In addition to mattresses and box springs, we can also remove old and unwanted bed frames and headboards from your home.

Everything Is Included

  • Removal from anywhere—no need to move it outside
  • All loading and clean-up
  • Transportation expenses
  • Disposal and environmental fees

We Take All Types of Mattresses

  • Inner-Spring Mattresses
  • Futons
  • Foam Mattresses
  • Box Springs
  • Old Cushions
  • Platform Beds
  • Mattress Foundations
  • Adjustable Base Mattresses
  • Latex Mattresses
  • Water Or Air Beds
  • Gel & Pillow Top Mattresses
  • Memory Foam Mattresses

Mattress We Don't Take

  • Mattresses that contain hazardous or toxic waste
  • Mattresses with bed bugs

Why Choose Speedy Move To Remove And Recycle Your old mattress

When you call a team of professionals like those at Speedy Move, all the stress and hassle that comes with old mattress removal disappears. Our mattress removal service is fast and efficient so you can enjoy a newly clutter-free space without having to sacrifice any of your limited free time.
Additionally, we always handle the items we take responsibly, so you can rest assured that you’ve done your part for proper mattress removal. Let us do all the heavy lifting for you.
When you need a mattress haul away service in Causeway Bay, bed disposal in North Point, or a mattress pick-up service in Mid-levels, we’re in your neighborhood—find Speedy Move location near you.

how our pricing works

The final cost of a mattress pick-up can vary depending on whether you're getting rid of other items too, and how much space everything takes up in the truck.

Speedy Move is always happy to provide you with an online, no-obligation estimate, so don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions about booking an old mattress pick-up service.

Recycling & donating old mattresses

It is difficult and expensive to dispose of old discarded mattresses. They are hard to compact, take up a lot of space in landfills, and get caught up in the incinerator which adds up to the disposal cost. This makes recycling a mattress the better alternative.
Foam Padding: Can be turned into carpet underlayment or animal bed padding/carpet padding
Fabric / Fibers: Can be used in industrial oil filters and other textile applications
Box springs: Can be recycled as metal scraps, used to make new appliances and building materials
Wooden frames: Can be shredded to produce landscaping mulch or burned as an alternative fuel source
Additionally, if the mattress is in good condition, we can also donate it to a local charity to ensure it gets as much use as possible.

Mattress Disposal and Removal FAQ

Here are some good options for the disposal and removal of mattresses in a responsible way.

  1. If your mattress is still in a good usable condition, then you can list it on Carousell or other online marketplaces for a price or under the “free” category.
  2. Check with the local charities if they are allowed to accept old mattresses, and if they do, then you can donate your mattress that’s in a usable condition.
  3. Check with your mattress brand to see if they will take your old mattress back when delivering a new one. Many brands have this policy to take back the old mattress if it’s in an acceptable condition.
  4. Contact Speedy Move and schedule a mattress pickup at your convenience to dispose of in an environmentally friendly manner where possible.
  5. If you're looking for more options, head to our guide on how to dispose of your mattress.

If you are dealing with a bed bug problem, please let us know ahead of time when you book your on-site estimate. If we’re able to accept it, we ask that you have a pest control professional treat and wrap your mattress completely in plastic before we arrive to pick up the old mattress. It should also be labeled as “Contains Bed Bugs” to alert others who may handle the mattress. This helps to ensure that the bed bugs from your mattress aren't spread to other people's homes.

Absolutely! As long as your mattress is in good condition, it can be donated. This means your mattress should be free from stains, rips, or tears, and not be broken in any way. Each local charitable organization that accepts mattress donations will have slightly different standards for what they take, so it’s best to check with them before you drop it off.

Yes, old bed mattresses can be recycled and the practice is fairly common. Through mattress recycling, approximately 80-90% of the mattress can be reused. That’s quite a lot of material that can be reused and turned into new products! These materials can also be processed and reused to make upcycled mattresses that are as good as brand-new ones.

Steel springs, wood frames, stuffing, and fabric are all contained in a mattress and can be recycled and reused in different ways. However, mattresses can’t simply be left out for pickup with your regular recycling. You’ll often need to find a facility that specializes in the mattress recycling process, and you’ll need to transport it there on your own. But, if you can’t transport it to your local recycling center, junk removal services can help accommodate you.

When you decide to recycle your old mattress, you help reduce the amount of waste that ends up in your local landfill. Many parts of the mattress need to be recycled, as they take decades to decompose if they end up in a landfill. Read more here if you'd like to find out why it's important to recycle your old mattress.

There are several signs that it's time to get a new mattress. These include:

  1. The mattress is over 8 years old. 
  2. It creaks or squeaks when you move on it. 
  3. It rolls you toward the center when you lie down.
  4. Your back hurts when you get up in the morning.
  5. You don’t feel like you get a restful sleep each night. 
  6. The mattress noticeably sags in the middle. 
  7. You often wake up feeling congested due to dust allergies.


Sleeping on an old mattress could have long term effects on your health, so it’s important to address the issue as soon as possible.

Yes, old mattresses often cause allergies. If you have allergy symptoms only at night time, your mattress could be infested with dust mites! They are one of the most common household allergens and like to hide in the cotton folds of your mattress. If you think this is the case, it’s best to get rid of the mattress immediately and get a new one that is dust mite resistant. 

Most cities have regulations against illegally dumped mattresses, including not disposing of them in local landfills or leaving them behind your dumpster. Leaving used mattresses on the side of the road can be more than unsightly, it can attract pests and negatively impact the environment. Some cities have designated recycling facilities, and residents are required to use them. If you're unsure of how to legally haul away a mattress, call the mattress disposal pros at Speedy Move.

Sofa Disposal and Removal FAQ

Depending on where you live, different sofa donation options may be available to you. Start by researching what donation centers and charities are available in your city. If you find one you like, you can ask them about their donation process. Different charities have different requirements for donations and often require you to fill out forms, send in pictures, and wait to hear back from them.

Once you've confirmed they can take your sofa, you'll have to work out how to get it to them. If they pick it up, make sure to coordinate a day that they can come by to get it on and get a friend's help to bring your old couch outside. If not, you'll need that friend's help and a truck or large van to transport the couch to the charity.

Want to leave all that work in the hands of professionals and get rid of your old sofa today? Call Speedy Move and ask about our same-day pick up availability to get rid of your sofa fast and let experienced professionals responsibly dispose of or repurpose your old couch.

With a set of your average handyman tools and a clear area, start by removing the cushions and identifying visible and hidden screws, bolts, or fasteners. Remove those fasteners and begin disassembling the frame and arms into organized piles.
With the parts disassembled in organized piles, make sure to wrap them up in ways that set you up for success in reassembling them later. Put any small screws or washers in a plastic ziplock bag and pack away pieces of the frame in the order you disassembled them.
For all the details, check out our guide on how to take apart a couch for moving, disposal, and recycling.

Depending on your location, you’ll likely have one of the following options for local waste collection:
1. Schedule a pickup with your local government waste collection which will be at least 2 weeks away (in some locations, it can be as far away as 6 weeks). In most locations, you’ll also have to tell them some details about your pickup, like size and address.
2. Your local government waste collection will have designated days for large furniture and appliance pickups. These days can be as far apart as one pickup day every 3 months. You’ll have to check your local waste collection website to see how far away your next large item collection day will be.
There’s always a third option where you use professional Junk Removal services to save time and let professionals do all the heavy lifting for you. When you book with Speedy Move, we can often be there the same day, if you book early enough.

The best way to get rid of your old furniture will depend greatly on where you're located. The easiest way will always be calling a professional Junk Removal service like Speedy Move
We recommend checking with your local government's waste management services as they sometimes offer a free pickup service a few days a year. If the timing works out for you, this could be a great solution!
If the pick up date is too far away or you can't carry your couch out of your home and to the designated pickup location, you can check if any local charities offer a pickup service and be happy you are giving your sofa a second life.
When the materials aren't in good enough condition or if the local charities aren't accepting more donations, you'll need to plan an alternative like getting the couch to the right recycling facility yourself.
Speedy Move will always be right around the corner and happy to help with you easy couch removal and disposal if you need us.

Trash Removal FAQ

Every waste management service has their own restrictions on what sorts of trash they’ll collect. If you’re looking for some help getting rid of large or unusual junk, call Speedy Move today! We’ll come to you and do all the heavy lifting.

The simple answer is no, because it is illegal to throw batteries in trash! Never throw batteries or items that contain batteries in the trash or recycling bins. Most batteries, regardless of type, contain toxic chemicals such as Ion, Cadmium, Lead, Lithium, or Sulfuric Acid. Batteries can cause fires in recycling facilities. If old batteries go into landfill, the toxic pollutants can leak out and damage fragile ecosystems and contaminate groundwater. Batteries must be removed from devices, separated from regular household trash and disposed of properly.

If you miss your garbage truck and have too much trash to wait until the next collection day, there are other trash pickup options in your area.
The first option is to take your trash to your local dump or recycling center. However, taking your trash there yourself means sorting it, loading and unloading it, and taking time out of your day.
Save yourself the stress and let Speedy Move take your trash for you. We are fully insured, do all the heavy lifting, and recycle whenever possible to save you time and put your mind at ease.

Reducing waste in your home is easier than you think. Here are some steps to help you get started:

  1. Recycle paper, metal, and plastics whenever possible.
  2. Buy reusable bags and repurpose your plastic bags.
  3. Prepare fresh meals at home rather than eating out and using disposable food containers.
  4. Buy bulk items and use reusable containers.
  5. Create a compost pile for organic waste.
  6. Learn how to patch and repair instead of buying new things when something breaks.
  7. Use reusable dishes instead of one-time use disposable plates.
  8. Upcycle broken items into new ones.
  9. Always donate old items before throwing them in the trash.

Reducing food waste at home requires discipline, but it doesn’t have to be difficult. Here’s a list of ways you can cut back on creating food waste at home:

  1. Shop for food with a plan in mind.
  2. Avoid over-portioning.
  3. When you have leftovers, eat them.
  4. Learn how to properly store your food for maximum shelf life.
  5. Organize your pantry and fridge so that it works for you.
  6. Only buy food you believe you will eat.
  7. Keep track of what and how much you are throwing away.
  8. Start meal prepping.
  9. Never shop hungry.
  10. Freeze and preserve extra fruits and vegetables.
  11. Buy fresh foods that will stay ripe until you'll eat them.

Plastic makes up a large amount of solid waste in landfills and can take centuries to break down. And unfortunately, the more plastic is used, the more valuable space it takes up in landfills.

However, there are several ways you can help reduce plastic waste:

  1. Buy cardboard box products instead of plastic bottles.
  2. Use bulk bins and reusable bags instead of one-time purchases.
  3. Switch from plastic straws to paper or metal ones.
  4. Stop chewing gum - it’s made of plastic, or synthetic rubber.
  5. Use reusable containers at home.
  6. Bring your own take-out bag instead of using the styrofoam containers most restaurants use.
  7. Switch from disposable lighters to matches or a refillable one.
  8. If you can manage, cloth diapers generally have a lesser impact on the environment than standard disposable diapers.
  9. Use metal silverware instead of plasticware at home.
  10. If you like juices, make them fresh instead of buying them in a plastic bottle.
  11. Create your own cleaning products with simple ingredients from home.
  12. Switch from disposable razor blades to a razor with replaceable blades.
  13. Instead of buying pre-packaged bread, make your own.
  14. If you’re buying meat, buy it from the deli and wrap it in paper.

Removing an air conditioner unit from a window or wall safely requires following the steps below to ensure that it’s done without causing damage to the unit or surrounding structures. Here's a step-by-step process to safely remove an air conditioner unit:
Set up the AC unit and surrounding workspace for a safe removal. Make sure to turn off the air conditioner. Unplug it from it’s electrical outlet and ensure there is no connection to live electricity. Clear the area surrounding the AC so you don’t accidentally knock anything else over. Grab any necessary tools like screwdriver.
Secure the unit and disconnect attachments. If the AC unit is mounted somewhere precarious like a window ledge, find something sturdy like a chair or table that can stop it from falling off once you start removing any screws or other mounting hardware. If there are drainage hoses or window seals, disconnect them carefully from the unit.
Remove the mountain hardware. Mounting hardware can include screws, brackets, or support bars holding the unit in place. Use appropriate tools depending on your air conditioning unit.
Remove and transport the unit. Now that the unit is fully separated from your window or wall, carefully remove the unit and take it to your car for transportation to the recycling facility or its pickup destination. Always take safety precautions when doing heavy lifting including keeping your back upright at all times, not carrying anything too heavy, and having someone spot or support you.
By following these steps, you can safely remove an air conditioner unit from a window or wall without causing damage to the unit or surrounding structures. If you're unsure about any aspect of the removal process, call the professionals at Speedy Move.

There are a small handful of locations where they may take these appliances on bulk pickup days. It's best to check with your local waste management facility or city government for specific guidelines.

To recycle your old washer and dryer, you’ll need to check with your local government recycling facility where the drop-off location is for appliances to start.
Once you know where it’s going, it’s time to remove the washer and dryer from your home. If you're capable of doing this yourself, the process may be straightforward. However, due to the size and weight of these appliances, professional assistance may be required.
Then, it’s time to haul your washer and dryer over to the local recycling facility you identified earlier to drop them off for recycling.

Here's a step-by-step guide on how to safely remove a washer and dryer.
Before starting, gather the necessary tools which include a screwdriver, adjustable wrench, and possibly a dolly.
Disconnect the power. Safety should be your top priority when dealing with appliances. Before you start, ensure that the washer and dryer are unplugged from the electrical outlet.
Turn off the water supply. Locate the water supply valve, which is usually near the washer, and turn it off. This prevents any water from flowing into the washer while you're removing it.
Disconnect the water supply line. Use an adjustable wrench to disconnect this line. Be prepared for some water spillage - have a bucket and towels ready to catch and clean up any water that comes out.
Disconnect the drain line. The drain line typically runs from the washer to either the wall or a laundry sink. Loosen the clamp holding the drain line in place and carefully remove the line. Again, be prepared for some water to come out.
Remove the washer and dryer. Most washers and dryers are heavy and may require a dolly to move. Be careful not to pull too hard as there may be connections at the back.
By following these steps, you can safely remove washers and dryers from your home without causing damage to the units or surrounding structures. If you're unsure about any aspect of the removal process, call the professionals at Speedy Move!

Before you get rid of your old grill or BBQ, you’ll need to remove the propane tank. While Speedy Move can safely remove your old grill and other components, we’re often not able to remove old propane tanks. 
Many recycling depots, transfer stations, and landfills are able to accept old propane tanks for disposal. It’s best to check with your local recycling center first to see if they can be recycled in your area. If not, you may need to drop it off at a landfill or transfer station yourself.

Since we’re usually not able to remove propane tanks for you, we ask that you ensure the propane tank is fully disconnected before we remove it. Here are some tips on how to safely remove your propane tank:
1) Make sure your propane grill is turned off.
2) For a refillable tank, close the tank valve (turn it all the way to the right, or clockwise). Small disposable propane tanks don’t usually have valves, so you can simply unscrew the tank to remove it.
3) Once the valve is shut, twist off the threaded pressure regulator.
4) Remove the tank from the grill. (It may be secured with a bolt or screw—simply remove this to separate the tank.)  
5) Place your tank in a safe spot—do not store it indoors, even if it’s empty!  

While it’s not necessary to thoroughly clean the grill before removal, we recommend removing any loose debris or ashes for easier handling. Our team will take care of the rest, including disassembly and transportation.

Refrigerator Disposal and Removal FAQ

If you’re looking to move or just upgrade your kitchen, you may find it hard to haul away a refrigerator on your own.
If you're wondering what to do with old or broken refrigerators, here are some ideas:
1) Contact your local waste management company
The local waste management division may offer to pick up heavy appliances such as old fridges and freezers and recycle them if contacted in advance. Typically, local government waste management will only pick up old refrigerators on certain days, usually only once a month.
2) Talk to Your Local Scrap Metal Recycler
Old appliances consist of many recyclable metal parts and there are many local scrap metal recyclers who can use and recycle refrigerator parts. If you can lift and transport your old appliances on your own, see what scrap metal recycling companies near you might take it.
3) Contact your electric utility company
Some electric utility companies also offer refrigerator disposal services if you’re buying a new fridge. When buying a new fridge, check if your utility company or your fridge supplier will take the old one during the installation process.
4) Donate the refrigerator if it still works
If your refrigerator is in a good working condition, you can donate it to a local charity, retirement homes, or local shelters. You can deliver it yourself or some charities may pick up your refrigerator if it’s of a high enough quality and you can wait for their schedule to be available for the pickup.
5) Contact your junk removal company in your city
Local junk removal companies such as Speedy Move can help you dispose of your old broken refrigerator, fridge, freezers, refrigerant tanks, coolants, etc. for a fee. We specialize in efficient and eco-friendly fridge disposals and recycle them wherever possible. With our services, we can often pick up your old appliances on the same day you call, and we’ll even sweep up when we leave. If your refrigerator is in working condition, we will work with local charities and organizations to see if it can be donated. We’ll handle fridge and freezer disposal for you. You won’t have to lift a finger!

If you’re looking to move or just to upgrade your kitchen, you may find yourself ready to part ways with your fridge. When it’s time to start thinking about disposing of your old refrigerator, Speedy Move can help you dispose of it responsibly. We always make sure to donate items to local charities or organizations, or take them to the appropriate recycling facilities whenever possible.
When you hire Speedy Move to take care of your refrigerator disposal, you can rest assured that it will be properly disposed of, and you won’t have to lift a finger!

You sure can! Most fridges and freezers contain harmful oils and chemical refrigerants that need to be carefully removed and properly disposed of to avoid harming the environment. Once this process is complete, the fridge can be broken down into separate parts for recycling.

The easiest way is to find Speedy Move and we’ll take old fridges and other unwanted appliances to the recycling center for you. The unit is dismantled and sorted into metals, plastics, and glass. Metals undergo crushing, shredding, and magnetic sorting to separate steel, iron, and valuable non-ferrous metals. Finally, all materials are cleaned and readied for reuse, minimizing the environmental impact of disposing of large appliances. This refrigerator removal process ensures every part of your unit is efficiently recycled and repurposed.

If you’re getting ready to get rid of your refrigerator, there are a few steps you must take to make sure that your fridge is disposed of properly:
1. Unplug the fridge a few hours early to defrost the evaporator
2. Make sure you remove all foods and perishable goods
3. Tape down loose items such as shelves and compartments
4. Don’t try lifting the ridge alone - it’s more than a one person job! Call Speedy Move and let us do the work for you.

Warm food is the most obvious warning sign that your fridge has stopped working. Before you get ready to throw it out, there are a few areas to check first.
1. Check the temperature setting inside the fridge. If it’s set to a high temperature, it may be working fine.
2. Check the compressor behind your fridge and listen for the motor sound. If the motor runs but the temperature inside the fridge hasn’t cooled down, then the compressor might be broken.
3. Check the inside coils. If you see a large amount of frost buildup, the coils may be broken.
If this sounds like your fridge, it is best that you replace it immediately. Carpet Removal FAQ

To tear up your old carpet, pull the carpet free from the tack strip connected it to the wall with pliers. Once the carpet is free, pull the carpet up by hand. Remember to cut the carpet into smaller pieces as you go to make it easier to move and dispose of.

Once you’ve ripped up your carpet, you may notice some leftover glue on your foundation or walls. 

Here’s how you can remove carpet glue from your home surfaces:

  1. Remove as much glue as you can with a razor, scraper, sparkling knife, or 5-in-1 tool.
  2. Soften hard-to-remove glue with heat by pouring boiling water or steaming the area.
  3. Use your scraping tool to scrape away the softened glue.
  4. Repeat as many times as necessary.

Carpet is held in place by small planks of wood studded with nails known as tack strips. These pieces of wood can be reused when laying down new carpet. To remove your carpet from tack strips:

  1. Locate the tack strip by finding the nail head in the carpet.
  2. Place a pry bar between the floor and the tack strip below the nail.
  3. Hit the opposite end of the pry bar with a hammer to pop the nail up.
  4. Remove the nail.
  5. Continue this process until every nail in the tack strip is free.
  6. When the tack strip is free, place it in a trash bag.
  7. When all tack strips are removed, sweep the floor for any loose nails or splinters.

To remove carpet from stairs, start by pulling the carpet free from the tack strip. Pull the carpet towards the ledge of the stairs and use a utility knife to cut along the nose of the landing. Using both hands, pull the carpet from the vertical riser until the carpet is completely removed. Remember to cut the carpet into small, manageable strips as you go and place them to the side for proper disposal.

Carpet can be thrown into the garbage with other household waste. However, your local waste pickup service may not accept old carpet in large quantities. Instead, you may be required to bring the carpet to a designated waste drop-off facility, or wait for a bulk-trash pickup day.

Some municipalities allow carpet to be thrown away in dumpsters. However, the amount of carpet you throw away may be limited.
Rather than risk having the carpet not accepted, check with your local waste removal site first. Some companies may offer used carpet pickup or require you to transport your carpet to a facility on your own. 

Yes, nearly all types of carpet can be recycled. Carpet is made from a combination of fibers, plastics, and chemicals that make it hard to break down in landfills. And because most old carpet is thrown away in large quantities, many trash collectors will not accept it.
When a carpet is brought to a recycling center, it is broken down into its raw components so it can be reused in new products, including plastic found in household items, auto interior parts, engines, industrial flooring, and even parking barriers.

Carpets are made of complex fibers, chemicals, and plastics that are hard to break down in landfills. Between the effect used carpet has on the environment and the limit on how much will be accepted by  trash pickup companies, your best bet may be to recycle your old carpet.

Why should you hire a professional electronic waste recycling and disposal service?

Hiring a professional electronic waste (e-waste) recycling and disposal service ensures that your old devices are handled in an eco-friendly and responsible manner. If your electronics are still functional, a professional service like Speedy Move works to extend their life by partnering with local charities for donation. This approach reduces waste, giving your devices a second life while benefiting those in need and promoting a circular economy.
When donation isn’t possible or charities are not accepting items, a professional service guarantees that your electronics are recycled properly. E-waste often contains valuable and potentially hazardous materials like metals, plastics, and toxic components such as lead and mercury. By safely reclaiming and repurposing these materials, professional e-waste services minimize environmental harm and contribute to a more sustainable future.

Electronic Waste removal: we take care of it all

Whether it's a single laptop or an entire home office setup, our e-waste removal professionals make getting rid of your old electronics a breeze. Our experienced team will carefully remove your devices from any room in your home or office, ensuring no damage to your walls or belongings in the process.
Once the electronics are safely removed, our clean, well-maintained trucks will either deliver them to a local charity for donation if they're still in working condition, or transport them to a certified recycling facility. As a trusted removal service, we are dedicated to minimizing waste and ensuring your e-waste is handled responsibly, making the entire process as eco-friendly as possible.

how our pricing works

The final cost of Electronic Waste removal can vary depending on whether you're getting rid of other items too, and how much space everything takes up in the truck.

Speedy Move is always happy to provide you with an online, no-obligation estimate, so don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions about booking an Electronic Waste removal service.

Electronic Waste Disposal and Removal FAQ

Electronic waste, or "e-waste," is a term used to describe discarded or broken electronic devices. This waste includes broken computers, televisions, stereos, VCRs, music players, DVD players, monitors, and cell phones. Many of these products may be salvaged, refurbished, reused, or recycled.

Getting rid of your old cell phones, computers, and televisions largely depends on the condition that they’re in.
Here are some responsible ways to handle your electronic disposal:
Locate an electronics recycling facility in your town.
Donate working electronics to local charities or nonprofits.
Donate or sell your e-waste for parts.
Check to see if your local retailers offer trade-in services or buy used goods.
Find out if any local retailers offer e-waste recycling.
Sell your old electronics online.
Attend a hard-to-recycle or e-waste recycling event.
Find out if your trash collection service accepts electronics.
Electronic devices should only be thrown in a landfill as a last resort.

Before e-waste is recycled, it is first inspected to determine if it can be refurbished or donated. Once it is ready to be recycled, the device is taken apart and the materials are organized into separate categories to determine what can be reused and what can be further processed.
Determining which parts can be reused or converted is important because many electronics contain toxic metals and chemicals that need to be disposed of in a careful manner. When an electronic device is dismantled, the toxic pieces are properly disposed of while the reusable pieces are used for other purposes.

Due to the presence of toxic materials and chemicals found in most electronic devices, many waste management companies do not accept old electronics in regular trash pickup or curbside recycling services. These same toxic materials also make it illegal to throw old electronics into the trash in many cities. To avoid being fined or damaging the environment, e-waste must be disposed of properly.

All e-waste thrown in the trash will end up in landfills. However, leaving old electronics in a landfill can have a harmful effect on the environment. Whenever possible, the most responsible way to handle e-waste is to recycle or refurbish it. Recycled electronics are processed at facilities and reused to make new products. Broken electronics that can be fixed or reused still have value and can be donated or sold.

When e-waste isn’t recycled, it ends up in the landfill where it is exposed to the elements. Over time these electronics – made from toxic materials such as lead, mercury, zinc, flame retardants, and chromium – can release toxins into the air and the soil, affecting the atmosphere and tainting groundwater supplies.
Taking the time to properly dispose of electronic waste can prevent these substances from making their way into soil, causing damage to plants and animals, and potentially harming our food and water supply.
When you use Speedy Move to get rid of your electronic waste, you don’t have to worry about where to take your electronics. We work with local charities and recycling facilities to ensure all the components are properly disposed of.

With the rate of cell phone ownership increasing every day, replacing your old phone with the latest model has become a standard for many phone owners.

Like many electronic devices, cell phones contain materials that can cause harm to the environment if left in a landfill. These chemicals can be released from the phone and contaminate the atmosphere and surrounding soil.

Here are some ways you can dispose of or reuse your old cell phone:

  1. Trade your old phone in when buying a new one.
  2. Sell your working phone online, to a friend, or to a family member.
  3. Keep your old phone as a backup or experimental phone.
  4. Donate your old phone to a charity or nonprofit organization.
  5. Take your old phone to an electronics recycling facility.
  6. Ask your phone retailer if they offer phone recycling.
  7. Check to see if your waste management service accepts electronics.

How to safely dispose of old batteries all depends on the type of battery you have. Alkaline batteries, which are the most common household battery types, are safe to throw away with your regular trash. However, car batteries and lithium batteries – which are often used in phones and computers – are not safe to be left in landfills.

Here are some ways you can get rid of old batteries:

  • Take your batteries to a local electronics recycling facility.
  • Stop by a local electronics retailer and leave them in designated bins.
  • Throw away all AAA, AA, 9V, and D-cell batteries in your trash can.

Getting rid of your old piano is not as simple as throwing it in the trash. Pianos are large and made of materials that do not break down naturally in landfills.
Here’s how you can properly get rid of your old piano:
Determine if your broken piano is beyond repair - if it can be fixed, it may have more value being donated.
Check to see if your local trash or junk removal service, charities, and recycling facility accepts pianos or offers piano disposal service.
Schedule a pickup time with piano movers.
Clear a path for the piano movers to carry the instrument through.
Moving a piano is more than a one-person job. Your best option is to hire professionals who have the tools to handle it for you.

One way to dispose of an old piano is to donate it. However, the size of your piano and the condition that it is in plays a large role in whether or not an organization will accept your donation.

Nonprofit organizations
Schools
Social groups
Retirement homes
Recreation centers
Service clubs

Donating to many of these organizations may be tax-deductible. Of course, there may be organizations in your area that also accept pianos in need of repair.

If you’re looking to give your piano a second chance at life, check with your local recycling centers to find out if they will accept a used piano and whether or not it will cost you money to deliver it.

If you're getting ready to get rid of your old piano, you may want to dismantle it first for easier transportation.

To dismantle a piano:

  1. Open the piano lid and key cover to see inside the piano
  2. Unscrew the piano desk, or the space where the sheet music rests, to expose the harp
  3. Loosen the screws on the piano key cover to remove
  4. Remove the lower board cover, or the wall that houses the foot pedals, to expose the lower mechanism
  5. Loosen the screws and remove the top lid
  6. Unscrew and remove the muffler felt that runs across the action, or hammers
  7. Remove the bracket screws to loosen and remove the action
  8. Pull each key straight up to remove and place aside
  9. Loosen the tension in every string on the harp by turning the tuning pegs counterclockwise for safety
  10. Loosen and remove the key bed
  11. Lay the piano down for stability
  12. Remove the side supports
  13. Finally, remove the piano harp
