item.title: How to Dispose of an Old Mattress in Hong Kong: A Comprehensive Guide
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Disposing of an old mattress in a densely populated city like Hong Kong can be challenging due to limited space, strict waste disposal regulations, and environmental concerns. However, there are several ways to responsibly get rid of your old mattress while adhering to local rules and minimizing environmental impact. This comprehensive guide will walk you through various methods for disposing of an old mattress in Hong Kong, ensuring you do it efficiently, legally, and in an eco-friendly way.

Why Proper Mattress Disposal Matters

Understanding why proper mattress disposal is important can help motivate responsible actions. Mattresses are bulky and often made from materials that are not biodegradable, such as metal springs, foam, and synthetic fabrics. When disposed of improperly, these materials can occupy significant landfill space and take years to decompose, potentially releasing harmful chemicals into the environment.

Additionally, improper disposal can lead to penalties and fines. By taking the time to dispose of your mattress properly, you are helping to reduce waste, protect the environment, and comply with local regulations. With the growing concern over waste management and environmental sustainability, every effort to dispose of bulky items like mattresses responsibly contributes to a cleaner and healthier city.

Option 1: Contact Your Building Management

Check Your Building’s Disposal Guidelines

One of the first steps in disposing of a mattress is to consult your building management. Many residential buildings in Hong Kong have specific guidelines or services for disposing of large items, including designated disposal areas or scheduled collection services for bulky waste. These guidelines help ensure efficient waste management and keep communal areas clean and safe.

Bulk Waste Collection Services

If your building provides a bulk waste collection service, this can be one of the most convenient ways to dispose of your mattress. Typically, you can arrange a pickup through the building management office. Make sure to follow any specific instructions they provide, such as wrapping the mattress in protective material or labeling it appropriately for collection. Some buildings may require you to notify them a few days in advance, so plan accordingly.

Advantages of Using Building Management Services

Utilizing your building’s waste disposal services ensures that your mattress is handled by professionals familiar with local regulations and the building's logistics. This option also minimizes the risk of illegal dumping, which can lead to fines for residents and management alike. Additionally, it often incurs no extra cost, making it a budget-friendly option.

Option 2: Sell or Give Away Your Mattress

Use Online Platforms

If your mattress is still in good condition, consider selling it or giving it away. Platforms like Facebook Marketplace, Carousell, and AsiaXPAT are popular in Hong Kong for selling second-hand goods. Posting your mattress online allows you to reach a wide audience quickly, and you might find someone in need of a good-quality mattress at a lower price.

Tips for Selling or Giving Away Your Mattress

When listing your mattress, provide clear, high-quality photos and a detailed description of its condition, size, and any wear or damage. Be honest about its age and any issues to ensure transparency. Highlight any features like memory foam or orthopedic support that might attract buyers. Offering delivery or assistance with transportation can also make your listing more appealing.

Local Community Groups

You can also check out local community groups on social media platforms or neighborhood apps like Nextdoor. These groups often have members looking for free or low-cost items, including mattresses. Posting your mattress in these groups can help you find a new home for it and avoid sending it to a landfill.

The Benefits of Rehoming Your Mattress

By rehoming your mattress, you extend its life and reduce waste. This approach is not only environmentally friendly but also helps others who might not afford a new mattress. Additionally, it fosters a sense of community by supporting your neighbors.

Option 3: Hire a Junk Removal Company Like Speedy Move Hong Kong

Convenience and Efficiency

For a hassle-free mattress disposal experience, consider hiring a junk removal company like Speedy Move Hong Kong. These companies specialize in the quick and efficient removal of bulky items, including mattresses. They provide door-to-door services, ensuring your mattress is disposed of properly without you needing to lift a finger.

What to Expect from a Junk Removal Service

When you hire a junk removal company like Speedy Move Hong Kong, you can expect a professional team to handle the entire process, from pickup to disposal. They ensure that your mattress is disposed of in compliance with local regulations, often recycling or donating items when possible to minimize environmental impact. This service is ideal if you need to dispose of your mattress urgently or if your building does not offer bulk waste collection.

Costs and Services

The cost of hiring a junk removal company varies depending on factors like the size of the mattress, your location, and any additional services required. It's a good idea to contact Speedy Move Hong Kong for a quote and discuss any specific needs or preferences you have. Some companies may offer additional services, such as disassembling the mattress for easier disposal or recycling, which can be beneficial if you’re looking to minimize your environmental impact.

Advantages of Using a Professional Service

Professional junk removal services provide peace of mind, knowing that your mattress is being disposed of responsibly and legally. They also save you time and effort, particularly if you have a busy schedule or limited means of transporting bulky items. Moreover, by choosing a reputable company like Speedy Move Hong Kong, you are supporting local businesses committed to sustainability.

Option 4: Explore Recycling Options

Mattress Recycling Programs

Recycling is one of the most environmentally friendly ways to dispose of a mattress. Several mattress recycling programs in Hong Kong can dismantle old mattresses and recycle the materials, such as metal springs, foam, and fabric. This process reduces waste and helps conserve valuable resources by reusing materials.

How to Recycle Your Mattress

To recycle your mattress, contact a mattress recycling program or facility in Hong Kong. Some organizations offer free pickup services, while others may require you to drop off the mattress at their location. Always check the specific requirements and make arrangements in advance to ensure a smooth recycling process.

Green Community Collection Points

Hong Kong also has green community collection points where residents can drop off old mattresses for recycling. These points are part of the government’s broader efforts to promote waste reduction and recycling across the city. You can find the nearest collection point by visiting the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) website or contacting them directly.

The Importance of Recycling Mattresses

Recycling mattresses helps divert waste from landfills and reduces the need for new raw materials. By breaking down mattresses into their component parts, recycling facilities can repurpose materials like metal springs, foam, and textiles for new products. This not only conserves resources but also reduces the environmental footprint associated with manufacturing new goods.

Option 5: Donate to Charity

Give Your Mattress a Second Life

If your mattress is still in good condition, consider donating it to a local charity. Donating not only extends the life of the mattress but also helps those in need. Several charitable organizations in Hong Kong, such as the Salvation Army and Caritas Hong Kong, accept gently used mattresses and distribute them to low-income families, refugees, or other individuals in need.

How to Donate

Before donating, make sure your mattress is clean and in acceptable condition. Contact the charity organization in advance to confirm they are currently accepting mattress donations and arrange for a pickup or drop-off. Some charities may offer free collection services for large items, making the process even more convenient.

The Benefits of Donating Your Mattress

Donating your mattress helps support those in need while also reducing waste. Charities often serve underprivileged communities, including low-income families and refugees, who may not have the resources to purchase new furniture. By donating, you are not only keeping your mattress out of the landfill but also contributing to a good cause.

Option 6: Be Mindful of Illegal Dumping

The Consequences of Illegal Dumping

Illegal dumping of mattresses is not only harmful to the environment but also against the law in Hong Kong. Dumping a mattress on the street or in unauthorized areas can lead to serious legal consequences, including fines and penalties. Always follow proper disposal methods to avoid contributing to littering and environmental degradation.

Tips for Responsible Disposal

To dispose of your mattress responsibly, choose one of the methods outlined in this guide. Whether through recycling programs, donations, or junk removal services, there are many options available that ensure your mattress is disposed of legally and safely.

Environmental and Social Impacts of Illegal Dumping

Illegal dumping can lead to significant environmental damage, including soil and water contamination and harm to wildlife. It also creates an unsightly and unhygienic environment for local communities. By disposing of your mattress properly, you help maintain the cleanliness and safety of your neighborhood.

Option 7: Consider Environmental Impacts

Reducing Waste and Repurposing

Before disposing of your mattress, consider whether it can be reused or repurposed. Sometimes, mattresses can be cleaned and repurposed

for other uses, such as a guest bed or camping mattress. Reusing or repurposing helps reduce waste and gives the mattress a new life.

Creative Upcycling Ideas

If you’re feeling creative, upcycling your mattress can be an enjoyable and eco-friendly project. Here are a few ideas:

  • Pet Beds: Cut the mattress foam into smaller pieces to make comfortable pet beds. This is a great way to repurpose materials and provide your pets with a cozy place to rest.
  • Outdoor Cushions: Use the foam to create durable outdoor cushions or seating pads for your patio or garden. These cushions can add comfort to your outdoor space and are easy to make with basic sewing skills.
  • DIY Insulation: Mattress materials can be repurposed as insulation for home DIY projects, such as soundproofing or insulating a small space. This can help reduce energy costs and improve the comfort of your home.

Upcycling: A Sustainable Choice

Upcycling is a creative way to give old items a new purpose, reducing waste and minimizing environmental impact. By transforming your mattress into something useful, you can contribute to a more sustainable lifestyle and inspire others to think creatively about reusing materials.

Conclusion

Disposing of an old mattress in Hong Kong doesn’t have to be a daunting task. By understanding your options and following the right procedures, you can dispose of your mattress responsibly and legally. Whether you choose to sell, donate, recycle, or hire a junk removal company like Speedy Move Hong Kong, each option plays a role in reducing waste and protecting the environment.

Taking these steps not only contributes to a cleaner, greener Hong Kong but also sets a positive example for others to follow. By being mindful of your environmental impact and choosing responsible disposal methods, you are helping to create a more sustainable future for everyone.

Encouraging Responsible Disposal

Remember, every action counts when it comes to waste management and environmental protection. By choosing to dispose of your mattress responsibly, you are playing a crucial role in maintaining the cleanliness and sustainability of Hong Kong. Encourage others to do the same and share your knowledge about the various disposal options available.

item.title: Features
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Fast and Easy

We offer same day service and our friendly customer service will help you throughout the process.

Professional Service

Speedy movers have over 10 years of experience. We arrive on time with a smile, work efficiently, treat you and your items with care and respect.

Eco-Friendly Removal

Our goal is to donate, repurpose, and rehome everything we possibly can, minimizing what ends up in the landfill.

item.title: How Our Service Works
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
How Our Service Works

  1. Send us the photos or video of items via WhatsApp (852) 9847 7838. Our customer service will reply you within seconds.
  2. We will give you a free quote after our assessment of your items. All inclusive price with no hidden fees.
  3. Book appointment with us and we can offer same day service.
  4. Sit back and relax. Our friendly and professional team will do all the heavy lifting.

item.title: Contact Info
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Contact Info

  • WhatsApp or Call: (852) 9847 7838
  • Address: Room N, 9/F, Kwun Tong Industrial Centre, 460 Kwun Tong Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong
  • Email: info@speedy-move.com

item.title: Furniture Disposal FAQs
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Furniture Disposal FAQs

If you’re looking to upgrade your home or move out, you may find it hard to get rid of your old furniture.
Here are some quick ways to dispose of old furniture:
1. Donate to Charity
One of the best ways to dispose of old furniture is by donating it to charity organizations. Many charities in Hong Kong accept gently used furniture that can be repurposed for those in need or used in shelters, community centers, or other charitable facilities.
2. Sell or Give Away
Selling or giving away your old furniture is another effective way to dispose of it. This method not only extends the life of your items but also provides an opportunity for others to acquire affordable furniture.
3. Utilize Government Services
The Hong Kong government provides several services for disposing of bulky waste. Utilizing these services can be an efficient way to ensure your furniture is disposed of properly without incurring costs.
4. Recycle Through Specialized Programs
Recycling furniture helps reduce waste and supports sustainability by reclaiming useful materials. Several organizations in Hong Kong specialize in recycling different types of furniture and materials.
5. Upcycle or Repurpose
Upcycling furniture is a creative way to breathe new life into old pieces. This method involves redesigning or reworking furniture to create something new and functional, often enhancing its aesthetic value in the process.
6. Use Furniture Exchange Programs
Furniture exchange programs are becoming increasingly popular as a sustainable way to dispose of unwanted furniture. These programs allow you to exchange your old furniture for other items or credits that can be used towards purchasing new or second-hand furniture.
7. Hire a Junk Removal Service
For furniture that is beyond repair or has no resale value, hiring a professional like Speedy Move is a convenient and efficient option. These companies are equipped to handle bulky items and ensure they are disposed of responsibly.

It’s best to avoid throwing your couch in or near a dumpster. It may seem like the easiest way to get rid of your old couch, but many garbage services aren’t equipped to handle couch removal. And even if they are, they often require old couches to be broken down before they can be removed.

Taking apart your couch is a multi-step process. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Gather the tools you’ll need—common examples include:
    • Screwdriver
    • Allen wrench
    • Staple puller
    • Box cutter
  2. Remove the cushions from the sofa
  3. Turn the sofa on its back in order to take apart the legs
  4. Use a staple remover or screwdriver to take apart the upholstery
  5. Disassemble the wood frame
  6. You’re done! Now, you can dispose of the couch’s individual components

You have a few options when it comes to old furniture removal:

  • Check with your city and see if they offer free pick up for large items. Regulations vary depending on the location you are in.
  • Sell or give your old furniture away for free and have the buyer pick it up from your home.
  • Donate it to a local charity. Some may offer to pick up the items for you, but you may have to drop it off yourself.
  • Haul it yourself to the dump. However, this can be tricky to organize, especially if you don’t already have a truck that can fit all your items.
  • Hire a professional junk removal service like Speedy Move to handle furniture pick up for you.

Our full-service junk removal offers straightforward pricing based on how much space your items occupy in our trucks. When you haul away furniture with us, you only pay for what you use, whether it's large furniture or smaller pieces. Furniture removal costs vary by location due to local disposal fees, but we always offer a competitive price. 

Since most offices contain a large amount of furniture, take an inventory of everything you don’t need to take with you when it comes to a commercial move. This helps keep track of what you want to take and what you need to get rid of.
Consider selling or giving furniture to your employees or donating them to your local charity. A professional junk removal service like Speedy Move can make the office furniture removal process easy for you.

Yes, depending on the type of wood used. If you have items that are made from untreated wood, these can be recycled and sometimes even composted. Most furniture is made of treated wood, which means it has been pressure-treated, stained, painted or varnished. This type of wood, along with particleboard and chipboard, is very difficult to recycle due to the chemicals in the varnishes, paints, adhesives, and other wood treatment products. The best thing to do with old treated wood furniture is to find a way to reuse it.

While we can remove old furniture in most situations, there are some instances in which we can’t dispose of unwanted items. We cannot handle hazardous materials, including chemicals, solvents, oils, and asbestos. Additionally, our removal services can’t accept items like storage and oil drums unless they're empty and both the top and bottom are removed. Oil and waste storage tanks also fall outside the scope of what we can properly dispose of while ensuring safety and compliance with environmental standards in the communities we serve. Learn more about what we can take.

It can get frustrating to dispose of your old furniture especially if they are large, bulky, and heavy. It becomes hard and sometimes dangerous to move it and carry it outside the house.
There are a few ways to get rid of your old furniture depending on the condition and if it’s damaged.
Usable condition
- Donate them to charities or NGOs
- Put them out on online sale

Broken, Damaged, unusable
- Take them to the junkyard
- Call a professional junk removal service to take your old furniture and dispose them / recycle them in a proper way

At Speedy Move, we provide a safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly furniture removal service. We make sure the old furniture ends up in the right place which can be a donation to a charity if they are still in good shape, or look to take them to a recycling facility if they are damaged beyond use.
No matter what, we do the heavy lifting for you and dispose of your old furniture responsibly.

item.content:encoded:
認可公共工程承建商

本公司為香港政府認可公共工程承建商（註冊編號：MWC 80/2010），具備法定資質執行各類清拆工程。專為企業客戶提供符合政府標準的專業清拆還原服務，確保工程合法合規。

item.title: 清拆工程具體說明
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
清拆工程具體說明

Speedy Move 提供住宅、商業及特殊清拆服務，團隊持有政府認證資格，處理以下工程：
舊樓翻新、商舖清場、僭建物合法移除
餐廳油煙管道拆除、寫字樓清拆、天台屋結構處理
施工符合《建築物條例》及環保規範
選擇所需服務類型，獲取具體說明。

  • 住宅清拆
  • 店鋪清拆
  • 餐廳清拆
  • 辦公室清拆
  • 僭建物清拆
  • 結構還原

住宅清拆

針對舊樓、唐樓及私人住宅的翻新需求，提供完整住宅清拆解決方案。服務包括：剷除牆身瓷磚、地台拆除、舊有喉管及電線移除。團隊嚴格遵守屋宇署指引，處理石棉瓦、發霉隔間等危險建材，施工全程使用防塵密封設備，避免影響鄰居。工程結束後，將現場還原至交吉標準，並提供〈廢料處理證明〉及〈結構安全報告〉。

執行流程：現場評估 → 提交清拆價錢報價 → 簽訂合約 → 7日內開工。

案例：北角600呎舊樓全屋清拆，5日完成結構改動，節省客戶15%裝修預算。

店鋪清拆

專為零售空間設計的店舖清拆服務，涵蓋貨架拆除、燈箱招牌拆卸、地台還原。熟悉商場及地舖裝修規例，可於4個工作日內完成2,000呎空間清場。採用模組化拆解技術，90%金屬支架及玻璃可回收，減少建築廢料。提供「夜間施工」方案，避免影響日間營業。

核心文件：簽約時提供〈工程時間表〉及〈廢物分類計劃〉。

優勢：處理商標專利構件時，簽署保密協議保障客戶權益。

餐廳清拆

處理餐廳結業或翻新的清拆工程，包括油煙管道拆除、廚房設備清運、油脂污染清理。團隊持有食環署認證，使用高壓蒸氣清洗機去除頑固油漬，避免衛生檢查問題。專業分解冷藏櫃、爐具及排氣系統，分類處理化學廢料。

特殊設備：配備防爆工具，安全拆除瓦斯管線。

承諾：確保符合食肆發牌標準。

辦公室清拆

執行寫字樓清拆及還原工程，包含間隔牆拆除、地台升高系統拆卸、網絡佈線移除。採用低噪音工具（平均音量＜65分貝），施工期間不影響同層企業運作。提供文件粉碎服務，確保商業機密不外洩。

流程：非工作時段施工 → 每日清理碎料 → 完工後交付〈工程完工確認書〉。

案例：金鐘甲級商廈15,000呎全層清拆，12日完成，獲管理公司書面認可。

僭建物清拆

專業處理天台屋、簷篷、非法間隔等僭建物拆除。團隊熟悉《建築物條例》，可代辦屋宇署審批文件。使用高空作業平台車及微型破碎機，安全拆除懸掛結構。提供緊急服務，接獲清拆令後72小時內動工。

必要文件：完工後提供〈清拆令完成證明〉及〈結構安全聲明〉。

風險管控：工程投保1,000萬港元第三者責任險，保障業主權益。

結構還原

修復因改動受損的樑柱、承重牆等結構，嚴格比對屋宇署原批圖則，誤差控制在±2cm內。採用鋼筋防鏽塗層及高強度混凝土，完工後提供〈荷載測試報告〉。歷史建築還原團隊持有古蹟辦認證，曾參與二級歷史樓宇復原項目。

技術工具：3D掃描儀器、混凝土強度檢測儀。

驗收標準：通過註冊結構工程師簽署確認，確保還原後100%合法安全。

✔ 週末48小時連續施工

12天完成工程，獲大廈管理處書面表彰

馬鞍山私人住宅單位清拆

成果：業主滿意度100%，順利進入裝修階段

item.title: 清拆服務常見問題
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
清拆服務常見問題

✅ 詳細工期分析

  • 標準住宅（300-500平方呎）：
    ✓ 基本清拆：1-2個工作日
    ✓ 含廢料清運：需額外0.5天
  • 商業空間（500-1000平方呎）：
    ✓ 辦公室：2-3天（需處理系統傢俬）
    ✓ 餐廳：3-4天（含油煙系統拆除）

✅ 影響工期關鍵因素

  • 建築結構（混凝土牆比石膏板多50%工時）
  • 廢料處理（高層無貨梯需加30%時間）
  • 施工限制（部分商廈只准非辦公時間作業）

✅ 業主須知

  • 建議預留10-15%緩衝時間應對突發狀況
  • 可要求每日進度報告（含現場照片）

✅ 報價組成要素

✅ 隱藏成本警示

  • 石棉檢測：$1500-3000（1985年前建築強制要求）
  • 夜間施工：加收20-30%（需申請噪音許可）

✅ 省錢建議

  • 自行拆除可回收物品（如金屬門窗）可減$3-5/呎
  • 非旺季（1-3月）通常有5-10%折扣

✅ 必備保險類型

  • 第三者責任險（最低$500萬保額）：保障鄰居或公共設施損壞
  • 工人意外險：法定要求，保障施工人員安全
  • 工程全險（可選）：涵蓋火災、水浸等意外

✅ 業主注意事項

  • 要求承建商出示有效保單副本
  • 確認保單涵蓋整個施工期

✅ 環保回收選項

  1. 可回收物品（金屬、塑膠、玻璃等）：
    • 交由政府認可回收商處理
    • 部分慈善機構接受捐贈（如傢俬、家電）
  2. 電子廢物（電腦、電視、冷氣等）：
    • 按環保署規定，由持牌回收商處理
    • 可查詢社區回收點或「綠在區區」計劃

✅ 無法回收的廢棄物

  • 運往政府指定廢料收集站
  • 確保符合環保法規，避免非法棄置

✅ 注意事項

  • 捐贈前請確認物品狀況（是否仍可使用）
  • 大型傢俬需自行安排運輸或聯絡回收商上門收取

✅ 驗收標準檢查表

✅ 文件核對

  • 必須取得：
    ✓ 清拆完工證明（列明工程範圍）
    ✓ 廢料處置記錄（載明重量/處理方式）
    ✓ 石棉檢測報告（如適用）

✅ 常見糾紛預防

  • 建議拍攝360度全景完工照存證
  • 雙方簽署「驗收確認書」

✅ 一般建議

  1. 短期工程（1-2天）：
    • 可留在屋內，但建議關閉施工區門窗
    • 敏感人士（如幼兒、長者）可考慮暫時避開施工時段
  2. 大型工程（3天以上）：
    • 若施工範圍廣或粉塵較多，建議暫時搬離
    • 可自行安排住宿或使用防塵措施（如密封房間）

✅ 注意事項

  • 清拆期間可能會有噪音及粉塵，請提前做好準備
  • 貴重物品建議自行保管或遠離施工區域

如有疑問，請提前與施工團隊溝通安排。

✅ 基本保障範圍

  1. 工程質量保證（通常6個月內有效）：
    • 若因清拆工程導致結構問題（如牆身裂縫、漏水），可安排免費檢修
    • 不包含後續裝修或其他工程造成的損壞
  2. 廢料處理確認：
    • 確保所有廢料合法處理，避免業主承擔環保責任

✅ 糾紛處理方式

  • 若對工程有疑問，可要求第三方專業驗樓師覆檢
  • 按合約條款釐清責任歸屬，確保公平解決

注意事項

  • 售後服務需保留完工證明文件
  • 非工程相關問題（如大廈原有結構缺陷）不在保障範圍內

如有疑問，可聯絡施工團隊查詢詳細條款。

item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
商舖清拆常見問題

✅ 標準工期（按面積計算）

  • 500平方呎以下（茶餐廳/零售店）：2-3天
  • 500-1000平方呎（大型餐廳/店舖）：3-5天
  • 1000平方呎以上（超市/酒樓）：5-7天

✅ 最小化影響方案

  • 夜間施工：22:00-06:00（需提前申請）
  • 分區拆除：保留部分區域繼續營業

✅ 快速復業保證

  • 完工後12小時內完成廢料清運

✅ 必須文件

  • 屋宇署「裝修工程通知書」（表格BA12）
  • 消防處「消防安全證明」（處理防火設施時）
  • 環保署「噪音許可證」（如需夜間施工）

✅ 我們包辦

  • 代辦所有申請（1-2個工作天完成）
  • 提供「申請進度追蹤」服務

✅ 專業拆除服務

  • 冷氣系統：持牌處理雪種（提供環保署FRP表格）
  • 油煙管道：防火級別拆卸（避免殘留油垢）
  • 大型招牌：分塊切割拆除（街道封閉安排）

✅ 合規處理證明

  • 簽發「設備拆除確認書」供業主存檔

✅ 還原標準

  • 拆除所有固定裝修（地板/牆身/天花）
  • 恢復大廈交樓標準（石屎地面+批盪牆身）
  • 水電總掣安全封閉

✅ 附加服務

  • 提供「交吉證明書」協助租約交接

✅ 專業控制方案

  • 三防措施：
    ✓ 粉塵：全密封防塵罩+工業吸塵機
    ✓ 噪音：液壓靜音破碎設備
    ✓ 異味：生物酶分解油污（餐廳適用）

✅ 鄰里關係維護

  • 提供24小時投訴熱線
  • 提前7天張貼施工通告

item.title: 餐廳清拆常見問題
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
餐廳清拆常見問題

✅ 標準工期（按廚房設備計算）

  • 小型茶餐廳（<50座位）：3-5天
  • 中型酒樓（50-100座位）：5-7天
  • 大型宴會廳（>100座位）：7-10天

✅ 最小化損失方案

  • 分區施工：先拆廚房後拆大堂
  • 夜間作業：23:00-06:00（需申請噪音許可）

✅ 執照保障

  • 提供「臨時衛生證明」協助過渡期營業

✅ 專業處理流程

  1. 油垢深度清洗（防燃爆風險）
  2. 防火級拆卸（使用防爆工具）
  3. 管道分段移除（避免結構損傷）

✅ 法定文件

  • 簽發「油煙系統清除證明」（食環署備案）

✅ 安全拆除標準

  • 冷藏櫃：專業回收雪種（持牌處理）
  • 煤氣管：註冊氣體工程師封喉
  • 油缸：環保署認可承包商處理

✅ 特別保險

  • 額外投保$1000萬火險（施工期間）

✅ 還原重點

  • 徹底清除廚房油漬（蒸汽清洗）
  • 排水渠專業通渠（提供CCTV檢測報告）
  • 牆身地面無縫隙（防蟲鼠滋生）

✅ 一條龍服務

  • 代辦食環署完工檢查預約

✅ 環保回收與捐贈方案

  • 可回收物品（金屬廚具、不鏽鋼設備等）：
    ✓ 專業分類後送往政府認可回收商
    ✓ 部分物品可安排現金回收（視狀況而定）

✅ 慈善捐贈服務（符合條件物品）：
✓ 聯繫合作機構（如「惜食堂」、「救世軍」）捐贈可用餐椅、餐桌
✓ 提供捐贈證明，協助申請免稅收據

✅ 無法回收或捐贈的廢棄物：
✓ 嚴格按環保署規定，運送至政府指定廢料收集站

item.title: 辦公室清拆常見問題
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
辦公室清拆常見問題

✅ 彈性施工方案

  • 非辦公時間施工：夜間或週末進行（減少干擾）
  • 分區清拆：先處理閒置區域，營運中區域後續施工
  • 最短工期：
    ✓ 小型辦公室（<300呎）：1-2天
    ✓ 中型辦公室（300-800呎）：2-4天
    ✓ 大型辦公室（>800呎）：按區域分階段

✅ 無縫銜接裝修

  • 清拆後現場即時清理，可直接進行裝修工程

✅ 專業拆解與回收

  • 屏風工作站：金屬框架100%回收
  • 辦公桌椅：可用物品捐贈慈善機構（提供捐贈證明）
  • 玻璃隔間：專業拆除並回收玻璃（避免破碎風險）

✅ 無法回收的廢料

  • 按環保署規定運至政府指定廢料站

✅ 機密與電子設備處理

  • 硬碟銷毀：現場物理破壞或消磁（提供銷毀證明）
  • 電線管路：持牌電工安全斷電及拆除
  • 伺服器機櫃：專業工具拆卸（避免損壞地板）

✅ 環保合規

  • 電子廢物（WEEE）由持牌回收商處理

✅ 標準還原服務

  • 剷除所有固定裝修（地毯/地板膠/牆身飾面）
  • 還原至大廈交樓標準（石屎地面+批盪牆身）
  • 水電總掣安全封閉

✅ 附加服務

  • 深度清潔（去除粉塵/殘膠）
  • 提供「交吉證明」協助租約交接

✅ 專業環境控制

  • 防塵系統：
    ✓ 全區密封防塵罩
    ✓ 工業級吸塵設備（PM2.5監測）
  • 噪音管理：
    ✓ 使用液壓靜音工具
    ✓ 嚴格遵守大廈施工時間

✅ 企業形象維護

  • 施工區設置品牌圍板（可印製公司標誌）

item.title: 僭建物清拆常見問題
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
僭建物清拆常見問題

✅ 常見僭建類型

  • 天台搭建物（鐵皮屋、玻璃屋）
  • 外牆懸掛式冷氣架或花架
  • 地下擴建（圍封露台、地庫）
  • 未經批准的間隔牆或閣樓

✅ 專業評估服務

  • 免費初步檢查（提供相片比對報告）
  • 屋宇署圖則核實（需額外收費）

✅ 法定程序

  • 必須向屋宇署提交「清拆通知書」（表格BD14）
  • 大型工程需申請「清拆同意書」（需結構工程師報告）

✅ 我們包辦

  • 代辦所有申請文件（3-5個工作天完成）
  • 協調政府驗收

✅ 專業防護措施

  • 鋼架臨時支撐（天台僭建物拆除時）
  • 防水即時修復（外牆拆除後48小時內處理）
  • 結構工程師現場監督（大型工程適用）

✅ 保險保障

  • 投保$1000萬第三者責任險（涵蓋鄰居單位損壞）

✅ 合規還原標準

  • 天台：修復防水層至原貌
  • 外牆：移除所有附加物並補回批盪
  • 地面：回填至原地台高度

✅ 政府驗收文件

  • 簽發「完工證明書」供業主存檔
  • 代辦屋宇署最終檢查

✅ 法律風險

  • 最高罰款$20萬及監禁1年
  • 強制清拆令（業主需承擔政府工程費）

✅ 補救方案

協助撰寫延期申請書（特殊情況適用）

緊急清拆服務（24小時內開工）

item.title: 網誌
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded: 網誌

item.title: Moving Step 1
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
搬遷流程

第1步：評估和報價

評估： 通過電話或電子郵件聯繫我們，討論您的搬家需求，包括您的搬家規模、您當前的位置、目的地以及您可能有的任何具體要求。一旦我們瞭解您的搬家要求，我們的團隊將安排評估您的物品和搬遷的後勤工作。

報價：此評估有助於我們確定所需的搬遷人員人數、所需的運輸類型以及處理易碎古董、鋼琴或藝術品等物品所需的任何專用設備。評估后，我們將為您提供詳細透明的搬遷服務報價。

item.title: Moving Step 2
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
第 2 步：搬遷日的準備工作

整理：檢查您的物品，決定要帶走什麼以及要處理或捐贈什麼。如果需要，我們可以協助棄置傢俬。

打包：您可以選擇自己打包您的物品，或者我們提供專業的打包服務。如果您更喜歡自行打包，請確保您有足夠的打包用品，例如箱子、膠帶、氣泡膜包裝和包裝紙。

item.title: Moving Step 3
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
第 3 步：搬遷日

庫存： 我們將對所有要搬遷的物品進行清點。每件商品都將仔細貼上標籤，以確保正確處理和放置在您的新地點。

打包：如果您選擇了我們的打包服務，我們將安全地打包您的物品，為搬家做準備。

拆卸：對於需要拆卸的物品，例如傢俬或大型電器，我們的團隊會小心翼翼地將它們拆開。

裝載：我們會將您的包裝物品裝載到我們維護良好且設備齊全的搬遷車輛上，確保您的物品在運輸過程中安全無虞。

item.title: Moving Step 4
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
第 4 步：運輸和卸貨

卸貨： 您的物品將被小心地從車輛上卸下。

開箱：如果您選擇了我們的開箱服務，我們將仔細拆箱並重新組裝您的傢俬和電器，將它們放在指定的房間內。

item.title: Moving Step 5
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
第 5 步：搬遷後服務和簽核

傢俱放置：我們的團隊將根據您的規格放置傢俱。

清除碎屑： 我們可以協助清除包裝材料和任何不需要的物品。

傢俱組裝：如果傢俬或電器因搬遷而被拆卸，我們將重新組裝。

最終檢查：在我們離開之前，我們將進行最終檢查，以確保您的所有物品都在正確的位置並且狀況良好。我們會讓您在搬遷中簽字以確認您的滿意度。

item.title: 常見問題 (搬屋)
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
常見問題

我們的價格已包含基本包裝、搬運及傢俬拆裝服務。額外費用可能適用於以下情況：

  • 樓梯搬運（無電梯或超過5層樓梯）
  • 特殊物品（如鋼琴、大型魚缸）
  • 偏遠地區（如離島或禁區）

是的，若搬運地點需行經樓梯（無電梯），每層樓梯加收 $50−$200/件大型傢俬（視重量和尺寸而定）。

建議至少 提前7天預約，旺季（月底/節假日）需更早。我們提供 急單服務（48小時內），可能需額外收費

全包套餐已含以下專業包裝服務：

  • 家具及家電：所有家具（床、衣櫃、梳化）及家電（雪櫃、電視）以 防刮塑料膜 全包裹保護。
  • 廚房用品：碗碟、玻璃器皿使用 氣泡紙 + 紙箱 分層包裝。
  • 易碎品：鏡子、藝術品等額外加固
  • 拆裝服務：拆裝標準家具（如床架、木櫃）。

基本套餐價格全港統一，但偏遠地區（如東涌、馬灣）加收 $200−500 運輸費。

我們會使用專業防震氣泡紙、防刮塑料膜和加固紙箱包裝所有物品，特別對易碎品和貴重家具進行雙層保護；同時提供全面運輸保險，每單事故最高可獲$2000港元損壞賠償保障，讓您搬屋更安心。

可以！我們有 專業鋼琴搬運團隊，配備滑輪和防震設備。費用根據類型而定：

  • 直立鋼琴：$800起
  • 三角鋼琴：$1,500起

紙箱需以10個為一組購買（每組$200），我們另免費提供氣泡紙、膠帶和標記筆，並鼓勵客戶自備環保箱袋減少浪費。

八號風球/黑雨：免費改期
黃/紅雨：照常服務（提供防水包裝）

取消：提前7天全額退款
改期：免費1次（提前7天通知）。

item.title: 本地搬屋服務包括
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
本地搬屋服務包括

住宅搬屋

箱袋雜物、大小家電傢俬、裝拆防護包膠、棄置傢俬、搬琴、執箱服務，適用公屋、居屋、私樓、唐樓、村屋及獨立屋。

辦公室搬遷

文件櫃、電腦設備、伺服器、辦公室、傢俬、會議桌等大型辦公傢俱拆裝運輸服務，提供下班後或週末搬運，減少業務中斷。

倉庫搬運及物流

大型貨物搬運服務、包括機械設備、貨架及存貨的點對點運輸、拆裝及重新擺位、24小時彈性安排及香港機場物流支援。

村屋/別墅搬運

擁有豐富的村屋及別墅搬遷經驗，針對香港村屋道路狹窄、樓梯陡峭、偏遠地區交通不便等特點。

棄置傢俬

處理各類廢舊傢俬，服務涵蓋大型傢俬搬運、專業拆解及環保處理，嚴格遵守香港環保署的廢物管理條例。

傢俬裝拆

服務包括床架、衣櫃、書桌等各類傢俬的安全拆解、搬運防護包裝、到新居後的重新組裝定位。

item.title: 常見問題 (辦公室搬遷)
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
辦公室搬遷常見問題

是的，Speedy 提供全包式收費，已包括包裝材料、標籤分類、設備拆裝、搬運及安裝服務。特殊需求或偏遠地區可能另收附加費。

包含。標準家具如辦公桌、會議枱、活動櫃等皆提供拆卸與重新安裝服務，不另收費。

我們有專門 IT 設備搬運流程，提供抗震包裝，確保資料設備安全不受損。

如需經樓梯搬運大型設備或文件櫃，每層樓每件可能加收 $50–$200，實際收費視樓層與物件體積而定。

可以，我們提供貼紙標籤及文件區分系統，協助員工分區打包與定位新座位區域，搬後更易整理。

建議至少提前 7–10 天預約，月底及公眾假期為搬遷高峰期，提早預約可確保檔期。

視乎規模安排人手，小型辦公室約 2–3 位搬運員，中型至大型則視工程複雜度安排 6–10 人。

目前我們專注於提供搬運、包裝和傢俬拆裝等核心搬遷服務，暫未提供倉儲或暫存服務。如您有倉儲需求，我們樂意協助您聯繫可信賴的第三方倉儲供應商，確保您的物品獲得妥善保管。

黑雨或八號風球當天可免費改期；紅雨或黃雨情況下則視情況決定是否繼續搬運，並採用防水包裝處理。

可處理如大型影印機、伺服器櫃、保險箱等設備，會提前安排專業器材與技術人員，並個別報價。

item.title: 倉庫搬運及物流常見問題
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
倉庫搬運及物流常見問題

是的，我們的倉庫搬運服務為全包方案，涵蓋基本包裝、搬運、貨架拆裝與重組等。如涉及特殊需求（如大型機械、夜間作業或禁區出入），可能需額外收費，具體費用將根據實際情況評估。

提供。我們專業團隊可協助拆卸、搬運及重組各類型貨架，並根據您的需求重新規劃倉儲空間，提升倉庫使用效率。

搬運費用主要根據倉庫面積、貨物數量與重量、搬運距離及所需人手等因素計算。我們建議您提前聯絡我們進行免費評估，以獲取準確報價。

是的，我們專門處理易碎品、貴重設備等特殊物品，提供專業包裝與搬運方案，確保物品在運輸過程中的安全與完整。

我們為每次搬運提供基本保險保障，最高可獲得港幣 $2,000 的損壞賠償。如需更高保額或特定保險，請提前與我們聯絡，我們可協助安排額外保險服務。

提供。我們可根據您的需求，安排貨物從倉庫直接配送至指定地點，確保物流流程高效順暢。

提供。我們可根據客戶需求，安排夜間或假日搬運服務，以減少對日常營運的影響。請提前與我們協商，以確保人手與車輛的安排。

是的，根據搬運需求，我們可提供各類搬運設備，包括叉車、吊機等，確保搬運工作安全高效。

很抱歉，我們目前不提供任何形式的倉儲或暫存服務。我們專注於倉庫搬運、物流配送、貨架重組與特殊物品搬運等項目。如您需要倉儲服務，建議聯絡第三方倉儲供應商或自助倉公司，我們亦可協助您將貨物運送至指定的倉儲地點。

如在搬運過程中發生物品損壞，請立即通知我們的工作人員，我們將根據實際情況進行評估，並按照保險條款進行賠償。

item.title: Moving Process
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Moving Process

Step 1: Assessment and Quotation

Assessment: Contact us via phone or email to discuss your moving needs, including the size of your move, your current location, the destination, and any specific requirements you may have. Once we understand your moving requirements, our team will arrange for an assessment of your belongings and the logistics of the move.

Quotation: This assessment helps us determine the size of the moving crew needed, the type of transportation required, and any specialized equipment necessary for handling items like fragile antiques, pianos, or artwork. After the assessment, we will provide you with a detailed and transparent quotation for our moving service.

Step 2: Preparation for Moving Day

Declutter: Go through your belongings and decide what you want to take with you and what you'd like to dispose of or donate. We can assist with furniture disposal if needed.

Packing: You can choose to pack your belongings yourself, or we offer professional packing services. If you prefer to pack yourself, ensure you have adequate packing supplies, such as boxes, tape, bubble wrap, and packing paper.

Step 3: Moving Day

Inventory: We will conduct an inventory of all items to be moved. Each item will be carefully labeled to ensure proper handling and placement in your new location.

Packing: If you have opted for our packing service, we'll securely pack your belongings in preparation for the move.

Disassembly: For items that require disassembly, such as furniture or large appliances, our team will carefully take them apart.

Loading: We will load your packed items onto our well-maintained and fully equipped moving vehicles, ensuring that your possessions are safe and secure during transport.

Step 4: Transportation and Unloading

Unload: Your items will be carefully unloaded from the vehicle.

Unpacking: If you've chosen our unpacking service, we'll carefully unpack and reassemble your furniture and appliances, placing them in the designated rooms.

Step 5: Post-Move Services and Sign-off

Furniture Placement: Our team will place furniture according to your specifications.

Debris Removal: We can assist with the removal of packing materials and any unwanted items.

Furniture Assembly: If furniture or appliances were disassembled for the move, we will reassemble them.

Final Inspection: Before we leave, we'll conduct a final inspection to ensure all your belongings are in the right place and in good condition. We'll have you sign off on the move to confirm your satisfaction.

item.title: FAQ (Moving)
item.dc:creator: Gavin Fung
item.content:encoded:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Our prices include basic packing, transportation, and furniture disassembly. Additional charges may apply for:

  • Staircase carrying (no elevator or over 5 flights)
  • Special items (e.g., pianos, large aquariums)
  • Remote areas (e.g., outlying islands or restricted zones)

Yes, if stairs are required (no elevator), each flight costs 50–50–200 per large furniture item (depending on weight/size).

We recommend booking at least 7 days in advance. During peak seasons (month-end/holidays), earlier booking is advised. Express service (within 48 hours) is available for an additional fee.

Our all-inclusive package covers:

  • Furniture & appliances: Wrapped in anti-scratch plastic film (beds, wardrobes, sofas, fridges, TVs).
  • Kitchenware: Plates/glassware packed with bubble wrap + boxes.
  • Fragile items: Extra reinforcement for mirrors/artwork.
  • Disassembly: Standard furniture (bed frames, wooden cabinets).

Base prices are citywide, but remote areas (e.g., Tung Chung, Ma Wan) incur a $200–500 transport surcharge.

We use shockproof bubble wrap, anti-scratch film, and reinforced boxes, with double protection for fragile/valuable items. Full transit insurance covers up to HK$2,000 per incident.

Yes! Our specialized piano team uses rollers and anti-shock equipment. Fees vary by type:

  • Upright piano: From $800
  • Grand piano: From $1,500

Boxes are sold in sets of 10 ($200/set). We free supply bubble wrap, tape, and markers, but encourage eco-friendly reuse.

No. 8 signal/Black Rain: Free rescheduling
Amber/Red Rain: Service continues (waterproof wrapping provided)

Cancellation: Full refund if notified 7+ days prior.
Rescheduling: 1 free change (7+ days’ notice).
